title_zh: 开场:酶的分类(EC 编号)与专一性——老师明确要求略过的部分
title_en: Opening: enzyme classification (EC numbers) and specificity - the part the lecturer tells you to skip

points.zh: 开场这一段是取舍指导而不是讲课内容:老师说左边那一大段酶的分类(enzyme classification)整段不用看。
points.en: This opening stretch is study triage rather than lecture content: the teacher says the whole enzyme classification block on the left can be skipped.

points.zh: 理由是只有专门做酶学研究(enzymology)的人才需要讨论某个酶到底属于哪一大类、哪一亚类;做病毒方向的不必背。
points.en: His reason: only people doing enzymology proper need to argue about which class and subclass a given enzyme falls into; virology work does not require it.

points.zh: 他提到那个"很拗口的命名法":EC 编号后面跟四个数字,分别代表大类、亚类(subclass)等层级。
points.en: He mentions the "awkward" naming system: an EC number followed by four digits standing for class, subclass and so on.

points.zh: 酶的专一性(specificity)——立体专一性、几何专一性——老师同样说"都不用看",与考试关系不大。
points.en: Enzyme specificity - stereospecificity and geometric specificity - is likewise dismissed as "no need to look at it", not closely tied to the exam.

points.zh: 真正开始讲的是酶与底物的关系(enzyme-substrate relationship):从这里起讨论酶和底物之间如何互作。
points.en: What he actually starts teaching is the enzyme-substrate relationship: from here on the topic is how enzyme and substrate interact.

points.zh: 全课的组织线索由此确定:先讲三个结合学说,再讲酶活力如何被正确描述和测定。
points.en: This sets the structure of the session: first the three binding models, then how enzyme activity is correctly described and measured.

extra.zh: 国家考试仍可能考六大类酶:氧化还原酶 oxidoreductase(EC 1)、转移酶 transferase(EC 2)、水解酶 hydrolase(EC 3)、裂合酶 lyase(EC 4)、异构酶 isomerase(EC 5)、连接酶/合成酶 ligase(EC 6)。2018 年新增第七类转位酶 translocase(EC 7)。
extra.en: A state exam may still ask the six enzyme classes: oxidoreductase (EC 1), transferase (EC 2), hydrolase (EC 3), lyase (EC 4), isomerase (EC 5), ligase (EC 6). A seventh class, translocase (EC 7), was added in 2018.

extra.zh: EC 编号的四个数字是分级的:第一位是大类(反应类型),第二位是亚类(转移的基团或键的类型),第三位是亚亚类(受体或辅因子),第四位是该亚亚类内的流水号。例如己糖激酶 hexokinase 是 EC 2.7.1.1。
extra.en: The four digits of an EC number are hierarchical: class (reaction type), subclass (group or bond involved), sub-subclass (acceptor or cofactor) and a serial number within the sub-subclass. Hexokinase, for example, is EC 2.7.1.1.

extra.zh: 专一性其实分三档:绝对专一性 absolute specificity(脲酶只作用于尿素)、相对/基团专一性 relative specificity(胰蛋白酶只切 Lys/Arg 后的肽键)、立体专一性 stereospecificity(只作用于 L-氨基酸或 D-糖)。这一分类在简答题里常出现。
extra.en: Specificity actually comes in three grades: absolute specificity (urease acts only on urea), relative or group specificity (trypsin cleaves only after Lys/Arg) and stereospecificity (acting only on L-amino acids or D-sugars). This triad is a common short-answer item.

quiz.q_zh: EC 2.7.1.1 这个编号中,第一个数字"2"表示什么?
quiz.q_en: In the EC number EC 2.7.1.1, what does the first digit "2" denote?

options.zh: 酶的大类,即反应类型
options.en: the main class, i.e. reaction type

options.zh: 酶的亚类,即转移基团
options.en: the subclass, i.e. group transferred

options.zh: 酶的亚亚类,即受体类型
options.en: the sub-subclass, i.e. acceptor type

options.zh: 酶在亚亚类内的流水号
options.en: the serial number within the sub-subclass

quiz.explain_zh: 四位数字自左向右逐级细分,第一位固定表示六大类之一,这里的 2 就是转移酶 transferase。"转移基团"对应的是第二位,"受体类型"对应第三位,"流水号"是最后一位。
quiz.explain_en: The four digits subdivide from left to right; the first always names one of the main classes, and 2 is transferase. The group transferred is the second digit, the acceptor type the third, and the serial number the last.

quiz.q_zh: 水解酶 hydrolase 这一大类催化的是哪种反应?
quiz.q_en: What kind of reaction does the hydrolase class catalyse?

options.zh: 不加水断键并生成双键
options.en: cleaving a bond and forming a double bond

options.zh: 以电子转移完成氧化还原
options.en: transferring electrons in a redox step

options.zh: 消耗 ATP 把两个分子连接
options.en: joining two molecules at the cost of ATP

options.zh: 以水为受体断裂化学键
options.en: cleaving a bond with water as acceptor

quiz.explain_zh: 水解酶用水作为受体断键。以电子转移完成氧化还原的是氧化还原酶,消耗 ATP 连接两个分子的是连接酶 ligase,不加水断键并生成双键的是裂合酶 lyase。
quiz.explain_en: Hydrolases cleave bonds using water as the acceptor. Electron transfer in redox belongs to oxidoreductases, ATP-driven joining of two molecules to ligases, and water-free cleavage generating a double bond to lyases.

title_zh: 锁钥学说与诱导契合学说:Fischer 与 Koshland
title_en: Lock-and-key and induced fit: Fischer and Koshland

points.zh: 最早的模型是 Fischer 提出的锁钥学说 lock-and-key model(老师课上把年份说成 1984 年)。
points.en: The earliest model is Fischer's lock-and-key model (the lecture gives the year as 1984).

points.zh: 比喻:底物像一把钥匙插进酶这把锁里,两者是一对一的刚性匹配。
points.en: The image: the substrate is a key inserted into the enzyme as a lock, the two matching one to one, rigidly.

points.zh: 锁钥学说的致命缺陷是无法解释逆反应:有些酶既能催化 A→B,也能催化 B→A,是双向的。
points.en: The fatal weakness of lock-and-key is that it cannot explain the reverse reaction: some enzymes catalyse A to B and also B to A, working in both directions.

points.zh: Koshland 随后提出诱导契合学说 induced fit:酶与底物天然并非 100% 匹配,可能只有 90% 匹配。
points.en: Koshland then proposed induced fit: enzyme and substrate are not natively a 100% match, perhaps only 90%.

points.zh: 只有当底物结合上去时,酶才发生构象改变,变成百分之百的匹配。
points.en: Only when the substrate binds does the enzyme change conformation and become a full match.

points.zh: 老师给出的逆反应解释:酶未结合底物时催化正向反应;正向反应完成后产物也能结合到酶上,产物结合使构象与底物结合时不同,于是可以催化逆反应。
points.en: The lecture's account of reversibility: the unbound enzyme catalyses the forward reaction; once the product forms it too can bind the enzyme, giving a conformation different from the substrate-bound one, so the reverse reaction can be catalysed.

points.zh: 老师明确说诱导契合"可以一定程度上解释"逆反应——是部分解释,不是完全解决。
points.en: He says explicitly that induced fit explains reversibility only "to some extent" - a partial account, not a settled one.

extra.zh: 锁钥学说的年份课上说成 1984 年,实际是 1894 年由 Emil Fischer 提出;Koshland 的诱导契合学说是 1958 年。差了整整九十年,考试写错年份会丢分。
extra.en: The lecture dates lock-and-key to 1984; Emil Fischer actually proposed it in 1894, and Koshland's induced fit came in 1958. That is a ninety-year slip, and the wrong year loses marks on an exam.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 酶催化反应可逆的根本原因是热力学,不是构象:酶不改变 ΔG 和平衡常数 Keq,它以相同倍数加速正、逆两个方向,反应走哪个方向由底物/产物的浓度比相对于 Keq 决定。诱导契合解释的是结合与催化的效率,不是可逆性本身。
extra.en: The root reason enzyme catalysis is reversible is thermodynamic, not conformational: an enzyme changes neither ΔG nor Keq, it accelerates both directions by the same factor, and which way the reaction runs depends on the substrate-to-product ratio relative to Keq. Induced fit explains binding and catalytic efficiency, not reversibility as such.

extra.zh: 诱导契合真正重要的推论(Pauling):酶的活性中心与过渡态 transition state 互补,而不是与底物基态互补。正因为对过渡态结合得更紧,才降低活化能 activation energy——这也是过渡态类似物是最强抑制剂的原因。
extra.en: The consequence of induced fit that really matters (Pauling): the active site is complementary to the transition state, not to the ground-state substrate. Binding the transition state more tightly is what lowers the activation energy - and it is why transition-state analogues are the most potent inhibitors.

quiz.q_zh: 锁钥学说(lock-and-key)由 Emil Fischer 于哪一年提出?
quiz.q_en: In which year did Emil Fischer propose the lock-and-key model?
quiz.explain_zh: Fischer 于 1894 年提出锁钥学说;1958 年是 Koshland 提出诱导契合学说的年份;1984 是课堂上的口误。
quiz.explain_en: Fischer proposed lock-and-key in 1894; 1958 is the year of Koshland's induced fit model; 1984 is the slip made in the lecture.

quiz.q_zh: 锁钥学说不能解释下列哪一现象?
quiz.q_en: Which observation can the lock-and-key model not explain?

options.zh: 酶只作用于特定的底物
options.en: an enzyme acting on one substrate only

options.zh: 同一个酶催化正逆两个方向
options.en: one enzyme catalysing both directions

options.zh: 酶与底物之间的互补结合
options.en: the complementary binding of substrate

options.zh: 酶对底物的立体专一性
options.en: the stereospecificity towards substrate

quiz.explain_zh: 互补结合、立体专一性、单一底物这三点正是锁钥学说提出来要说明的;它讲不通的是同一把"锁"如何既催化 A→B 又催化 B→A。
quiz.explain_en: Complementary binding, stereospecificity and single-substrate action are exactly what lock-and-key was invented to explain; what it cannot handle is how one "lock" catalyses A to B and B to A alike.

quiz.q_zh: 诱导契合学说(induced fit)的核心主张是什么?
quiz.q_en: What is the central claim of the induced fit model?

options.zh: 底物结合诱导酶发生构象改变
options.en: substrate binding induces a conformational change

options.zh: 酶与底物天然完全刚性互补
options.en: enzyme and substrate are rigidly complementary

options.zh: 酶结合前已存在多种平衡构象
options.en: several conformations pre-exist before binding

options.zh: 底物结合不改变酶的空间构象
options.en: substrate binding leaves the conformation intact

quiz.explain_zh: 诱导契合强调构象改变发生在底物结合"之后"、由底物诱导产生。刚性互补是锁钥学说;结合前已存在多种平衡构象是构象选择学说。
quiz.explain_en: Induced fit places the conformational change after binding, driven by the substrate. Rigid complementarity is lock-and-key, and pre-existing equilibrium conformations belong to conformational selection.

title_zh: 构象选择学说与酶活力概念的引入
title_en: Conformational selection, and introducing the concept of enzyme activity

points.zh: 目前比较前沿的说法是构象选择学说 conformational selection。
points.en: The currently more cutting-edge account is conformational selection.

points.zh: 该学说认为任何一个酶都有 open 和 close 两种状态,二者本来就同时存在。
points.en: It holds that any enzyme has both an open and a closed state, and that the two coexist to begin with.

points.zh: 酶催化何种反应,取决于底物结合到的是它的 open 状态还是 close 状态。
points.en: Which reaction the enzyme catalyses depends on whether the substrate binds its open state or its closed state.

points.zh: 老师举例:open 状态可能对应正向反应,close 状态对应逆向反应。
points.en: His example: the open state may correspond to the forward reaction and the closed state to the reverse.

points.zh: 酶实际处在构象动态 conformational dynamics 的状态,是一个持续的动态过程,而不是静止的单一结构。
points.en: The enzyme actually sits in a state of conformational dynamics - an ongoing dynamic process, not one static structure.

points.zh: 这个动态过程还会受到其他因素的影响。
points.en: That dynamic process is in turn influenced by other factors.

points.zh: 小结:锁钥、诱导契合、构象选择三个学说都是用来描述酶与底物结合关系的。
points.en: Summary: lock-and-key, induced fit and conformational selection all describe the enzyme-substrate binding relationship.

points.zh: 转入下一主题:酶的活力 enzyme activity 在广义上指酶催化某种反应进行的速率。
points.en: Transition to the next topic: enzyme activity, broadly defined, is the rate at which the enzyme drives a given reaction.

extra.zh: 诱导契合与构象选择的分水岭是构象改变的时间点:诱导契合是"先结合、后变形",构象选择是"构象先存在、底物挑一个结合"。真实的酶往往是两者混合(先选择、再微调契合)。
extra.en: The dividing line between induced fit and conformational selection is when the change happens: induced fit is bind-then-change, conformational selection is the conformations pre-exist and the substrate picks one. Real enzymes usually combine both - selection first, then a fitting adjustment.

extra.zh: 构象选择的证据来自 NMR relaxation dispersion 和单分子 FRET:未结合底物的 apo 酶已经在低比例上采样到与结合态(holo)相同的构象,底物只是把平衡拉过去。
extra.en: The evidence for conformational selection comes from NMR relaxation dispersion and single-molecule FRET: the ligand-free apo enzyme already samples the holo conformation at low occupancy, and the substrate merely shifts the equilibrium towards it.

extra.zh: 酶活力 activity 描述的是催化速率,不是酶蛋白的量。酶蛋白量用 mg 计,活力用 U 计,二者相除才是比活力 specific activity。
extra.en: Enzyme activity describes a catalytic rate, not the amount of enzyme. Protein amount is in mg, activity in U, and only their quotient is specific activity.

quiz.q_zh: 按构象选择学说,酶的不同构象是何时出现的?
quiz.q_en: According to conformational selection, when do the enzyme's different conformations arise?

options.zh: 只在蛋白变性的条件下出现
options.en: they appear only under denaturing conditions

options.zh: 在底物结合之后被诱导产生
options.en: they are induced after substrate binds

options.zh: 在产物释放之后才逐渐出现
options.en: they appear only after product release

options.zh: 在底物结合之前就已经存在
options.en: they already exist before substrate binds

quiz.explain_zh: 构象选择的要点是 open 与 close 构象本来就在动态平衡中共存,底物"选择"其中一种结合。结合后才被诱导产生构象改变是诱导契合的说法。
quiz.explain_en: The point of conformational selection is that open and closed states already coexist in dynamic equilibrium and the substrate selects one. A change induced after binding is the induced fit account.

quiz.q_zh: 老师给出的酶活力(enzyme activity)的广义定义是什么?
quiz.q_en: What broad definition of enzyme activity does the lecture give?

options.zh: 酶催化某种反应进行的速率
options.en: the rate at which the enzyme drives a reaction

options.zh: 酶与其底物结合的解离常数
options.en: the dissociation constant for its substrate

options.zh: 酶所催化反应的平衡常数值
options.en: the equilibrium constant of the reaction

options.zh: 酶蛋白在样品中的绝对含量
options.en: the absolute amount of enzyme in the sample

quiz.explain_zh: 活力是速率概念。蛋白含量是 mg 的问题,解离常数描述结合紧密程度,而平衡常数是反应本身的性质,酶根本不能改变它。
quiz.explain_en: Activity is a rate. Protein content is a question of milligrams, the dissociation constant describes binding tightness, and the equilibrium constant is a property of the reaction that the enzyme cannot alter at all.

title_zh: 初速度、活力单位 U / kat / IU 与比活力
title_en: Initial velocity, the activity units U / kat / IU, and specific activity

points.zh: 描述酶催化反应的速率,一般采用初速度 initial velocity:用反应刚开始时的速率来刻画酶的活力。
points.en: The rate of an enzyme-catalysed reaction is normally described by the initial velocity: activity is characterised by the rate right at the start of the reaction.

points.zh: 教材上罗列的各种活力单位老师认为不必细看;kat 这个单位他做了这么久实验从没见过。
points.en: The list of activity units in the textbook is, he says, not worth studying in detail; in all his years at the bench he has never encountered the unit kat.

points.zh: 真正需要一点概念的是 U(国际单位):在一定时间内将一定量底物转化为产物所需要的酶(量)。
points.en: The one worth a working understanding is U, the international unit: the amount of enzyme that converts a given amount of substrate to product in a given time.

points.zh: 关键提醒:U 不是一个通用概念,在不同的酶里代表的定义完全不一样。
points.en: The key caveat: U is not a universal concept - what it means differs completely from enzyme to enzyme.

points.zh: 具体差别在于"多少底物、在什么条件下、转化为多少产物",每种酶的规定各不相同。
points.en: The differences lie in how much substrate, under what conditions, converted to how much product - each enzyme has its own specification.

points.zh: 实际例子:买核酸酶等试剂时瓶上标的 "多少 U/µL",就是它的活力单位。
points.en: A practical example: when you buy a nuclease, the label reads so many U per microlitre - that is its activity unit.

points.zh: IU、kat 老师说在实际实验中很少见,不需要太了解。
points.en: IU and kat, he says, are rarely met at the bench and do not need much attention.

points.zh: 比活力 specific activity 就是 U 除以毫克蛋白(U/mg);老师认为这类定义是"玩文字游戏",意义不大。
points.en: Specific activity is simply U divided by milligrams of protein (U/mg); the lecturer regards such definitions as word games of little consequence.

extra.zh: 标准定义要记牢:1 U = 在规定条件下每分钟转化 1 µmol 底物所需的酶量;1 kat = 每秒转化 1 mol 底物所需的酶量(SI 单位)。换算:1 U = 1/60 µmol·s⁻¹ ≈ 16.67 nkat。
extra.en: Worth memorising: 1 U is the amount of enzyme converting 1 µmol of substrate per minute under defined conditions; 1 kat is the amount converting 1 mol per second (the SI unit). Conversion: 1 U = 1/60 µmol per second, about 16.67 nkat.

extra.zh: 比活力不是文字游戏,它是酶纯度的核心指标:纯化过程中总活力(U)只会下降,而比活力(U/mg)上升,纯化倍数 purification fold = 各步比活力 / 初始比活力,回收率 yield = 各步总活力 / 初始总活力。纯化表就是这样算出来的。
extra.en: Specific activity is not a word game but the central measure of purity: through a purification the total activity (U) can only fall while the specific activity (U/mg) rises. Purification fold is the specific activity at a step over the starting one, and yield is total activity at a step over the starting total. That is exactly how a purification table is built.

extra.zh: 三个量要分清:总活力 total activity(U,与样品体积有关)、比活力 specific activity(U/mg,与纯度有关)、转换数 kcat(s⁻¹,每个活性中心每秒转化的底物分子数,与酶的量完全无关,是酶的固有性质)。
extra.en: Keep three quantities apart: total activity (U, depends on how much sample), specific activity (U/mg, reflects purity) and turnover number kcat (per second, molecules of substrate converted per active site per second - independent of how much enzyme there is, an intrinsic property).

quiz.q_zh: 酶活力国际单位 U 的标准定义是?
quiz.q_en: What is the standard definition of the international unit U?

options.zh: 每分钟转化 1 mmol 底物的酶量
options.en: enzyme converting 1 mmol substrate per minute

options.zh: 每秒钟转化 1 µmol 底物的酶量
options.en: enzyme converting 1 µmol substrate per second

options.zh: 每分钟转化 1 µmol 底物的酶量
options.en: enzyme converting 1 µmol substrate per minute

options.zh: 每秒钟转化 1 mol 底物的酶量
options.en: enzyme converting 1 mol substrate per second

quiz.explain_zh: U 以微摩尔每分钟为准。每秒转化 1 mol 是 kat 的定义;毫摩尔每分钟和微摩尔每秒都不是任何标准单位的定义。
quiz.explain_en: U is defined in micromoles per minute. One mole per second is the definition of kat, while millimoles per minute and micromoles per second correspond to no standard unit.

quiz.q_zh: 比活力(specific activity)的表示方式是?
quiz.q_en: How is specific activity expressed?

options.zh: 每分子酶每秒的底物转化数
options.en: substrate molecules per enzyme per second

options.zh: 每毫克酶蛋白消耗的底物量
options.en: substrate consumed per milligram of protein

options.zh: 每毫克酶蛋白的活力单位数
options.en: activity units per milligram of protein

options.zh: 每毫升酶溶液的活力单位数
options.en: activity units per millilitre of solution

quiz.explain_zh: 比活力 = U/mg 蛋白,课上说得很直白。每毫升的活力是酶液的浓度,每分子每秒的转化数是 kcat,而每毫克消耗的底物量不含时间因素,不是速率。
quiz.explain_en: Specific activity is U per mg of protein, exactly as stated in the lecture. Units per millilitre give the concentration of the enzyme solution, molecules per enzyme per second is kcat, and substrate per milligram carries no time term so it is not a rate at all.

quiz.q_zh: 关于活力单位 U,课上强调的一点是?
quiz.q_en: What point about the unit U does the lecture stress?

options.zh: U 这个单位只适用于核酸酶类
options.en: the unit U applies only to the nucleases

options.zh: 所有酶的 U 定义条件完全一致
options.en: the conditions defining U are identical for all

options.zh: U 的数值直接等于酶的毫克数
options.en: the value of U equals the enzyme mass in mg

options.zh: 不同酶的 U 定义条件各不相同
options.en: the conditions defining U differ per enzyme

quiz.explain_zh: 老师反复说 U 不是通用概念:多少底物、什么条件、转化多少产物,每种酶规定不同。U 与毫克数无关(那是比活力的分母),而核酸酶只是他举的一个标注 U/µL 的例子。
quiz.explain_en: He repeats that U is not a universal concept: how much substrate, under which conditions, to how much product varies by enzyme. U has nothing to do with milligrams (that is the denominator of specific activity), and nucleases were merely his example of a product labelled in U/µL.

title_zh: 酶活测定的两种方法:固定底物量还是固定酶量
title_en: Two ways to assay enzyme activity: fix the substrate or fix the enzyme

points.zh: 老师特别说明这一段要讲,因为做 RdRp 一定会涉及酶活的测定。
points.en: He flags this section as one he will actually teach, because anyone working on RdRp will have to measure enzyme activity.

points.zh: 第一种方法:测定完成某一个定量反应所需的时间——例如给 10 毫克底物,测酶把它完全转化需要多久。
points.en: Method one: measure the time needed to complete a fixed quantity of reaction - give 10 mg of substrate, and time how long the enzyme takes to convert it all.

points.zh: 第二种方法:测定单位时间内一定量的酶能转化多少底物。
points.en: Method two: measure how much substrate a fixed amount of enzyme converts per unit time.

points.zh: 两种方法唯一的区别就是固定的对象不同:前者固定底物的量,后者固定酶的量。
points.en: The only difference between the two is what is held fixed: the amount of substrate in the first, the amount of enzyme in the second.

points.zh: 两种都可以做,但现在用得比较多的是第二种,理由很实际——比较好测。
points.en: Both work, but the second is the one mostly used now, for a very practical reason: it is easier to measure.

points.zh: 原因回到前面讲过的:酶不能改变化学反应的平衡(equilibrium),所以反应不会一直走到"完全转化"。
points.en: The reason goes back to an earlier point: an enzyme cannot change the equilibrium of a chemical reaction, so the reaction never simply runs to complete conversion.

points.zh: 他举例:10 毫克蛋白假如只有 30% 转化,"具体什么时候转化完"就根本无法定量,所以定量反应法难做。
points.en: His example: if 10 mg of protein converts only to the extent of 30%, then "when it finishes converting" cannot be quantified at all, which is what makes the fixed-quantity method hard.

points.zh: 第二种方法与前面的初速度概念相呼应:固定酶量、测单位时间的产物生成量,正是初速度的测法。
points.en: The second method ties back to initial velocity: fixing the enzyme and measuring product formed per unit time is precisely how an initial velocity is obtained.

extra.zh: 测初速度有个实操判据:取底物消耗低于 5%(线性区)内的数据。超出线性区,底物被耗尽、产物开始抑制、逆反应变得可观,测到的就不再是 v0。
extra.en: There is a practical criterion for an initial velocity: take data from the linear range, below about 5% substrate consumption. Beyond it the substrate depletes, product inhibition sets in and the reverse reaction becomes appreciable, so what you measure is no longer v0.

extra.zh: 实验上分连续法 continuous assay(实时读数,如 NAD(P)H 在 340 nm 的吸收变化、对硝基苯酚在 405 nm 的显色)和终止法 discontinuous/stopped assay(定时取样、加酸或 EDTA 终止后再测)。RdRp 常用放射性或荧光标记的终止法。
extra.en: Assays split into continuous ones, read in real time (NAD(P)H absorbance at 340 nm, p-nitrophenol colour at 405 nm), and discontinuous or stopped assays, where timed aliquots are quenched with acid or EDTA and then measured. RdRp work typically uses radiolabelled or fluorescent stopped assays.

extra.zh: "酶不改变平衡"的定量形式是 Haldane 关系式:Keq =(Vmax(正)·Km(逆))/(Vmax(逆)·Km(正))。它说明正、逆方向的动力学参数并不独立,酶把两个方向加速相同的倍数。
extra.en: The quantitative form of "the enzyme does not change the equilibrium" is the Haldane relation: Keq equals forward Vmax times reverse Km, divided by reverse Vmax times forward Km. It shows the forward and reverse kinetic parameters are not independent - the enzyme accelerates both directions by the same factor.

quiz.q_zh: 目前测定酶活力更常用的做法是哪一种?
quiz.q_en: Which approach to assaying enzyme activity is more commonly used today?

options.zh: 固定酶量,测单位时间的产物量
options.en: fix the enzyme, measure product per unit time

options.zh: 固定反应时间,测所需的酶蛋白量
options.en: fix the time, measure the enzyme protein needed

options.zh: 固定产物量,测底物的起始浓度值
options.en: fix the product, measure starting substrate level

options.zh: 固定底物量,测完全转化的时间
options.en: fix the substrate, measure time to full conversion

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说现在多用固定酶量、测单位时间转化量的方法,因为比较好测。固定底物量测完全转化时间是另一种可行但难定量的方法,其余两种描述不是课上给出的方案。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture says the fixed-enzyme, product-per-time approach is now the usual one because it is easier to measure. Fixing substrate and timing complete conversion is the other, workable but hard-to-quantify option; the remaining two are not methods given in the lecture.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么"测定完全转化所需时间"这种方法不好用?
quiz.q_en: Why is "time to complete conversion" a difficult assay to use?

options.zh: 底物浓度过低,反应速率无法被测出
options.en: the substrate is too dilute for any rate to be read

options.zh: 酶不改变平衡,反应难以完全转化
options.en: the enzyme cannot shift equilibrium to completion

options.zh: 酶会改变平衡,使产物过量地积累
options.en: the enzyme shifts equilibrium, over-accumulating product

options.zh: 酶在反应中被消耗,浓度不断下降
options.en: the enzyme is consumed, its concentration falling

quiz.explain_zh: 酶只加快达到平衡的速度,不改变平衡位置,所以底物往往只转化一部分(老师举的 30%),"什么时候转化完"没有明确终点。酶是催化剂,反应中不被消耗;底物浓度是实验者自己设定的,不是这个方法的固有问题。
quiz.explain_en: An enzyme only speeds the approach to equilibrium without moving it, so the substrate is often only partly converted (the lecture's 30%) and there is no well-defined endpoint. An enzyme is a catalyst and is not consumed, and substrate concentration is set by the experimenter, not an inherent flaw of the method.

title_zh: 为什么固定酶量测反应速率:酶活测定的基本思路
title_en: Why enzyme activity is measured at fixed enzyme amount

points.zh: 往反应体系里加酶,本身就是加进一份溶液,相当于稀释了反应体系,底物浓度随之改变。
points.en: Adding enzyme means adding a volume of solution: it dilutes the reaction system and changes the substrate concentration.

points.zh: 酶不能改变化学反应的平衡 equilibrium,所以"把 10 mg 底物完全转化"这个终点常常根本达不到,很难定量。
points.en: An enzyme cannot change the equilibrium of a reaction, so an endpoint like "10 mg of substrate fully converted" often never arrives and is hard to quantify.

points.zh: 两种测法的唯一区别:一种固定底物量、测完全转化所需时间;另一种固定酶量、测单位时间内的反应量。
points.en: The only difference between the two assay designs: one fixes the substrate amount and times full conversion, the other fixes the enzyme amount and measures how much reaction happens per unit time.

points.zh: 现在基本都用第二种:固定酶的量,直接测单位时间内酶催化的化学反应量,也就是反应速率 v,因为这个量好测。
points.en: The second design is now standard: fix the enzyme amount and measure the amount of reaction catalysed per unit time, i.e. the rate v, simply because that is what can actually be measured.

points.zh: 后面要讲的米氏方程 Michaelis-Menten equation 用的是同一个思路——固定酶量,看速率如何随底物浓度变化。
points.en: The Michaelis-Menten equation to come uses exactly this logic: hold the enzyme fixed and watch how the rate changes with substrate concentration.

points.zh: 常用的实验测定方法有分光光度法 spectrophotometry、荧光法 fluorescence、同位素测定法 isotope assay。
points.en: The common laboratory methods are spectrophotometry, fluorescence assays and isotope assays.

points.zh: 其中荧光法和同位素法现在用得最多,分光光度法知道是靠紫外吸收测的就可以。
points.en: Fluorescence and isotope methods dominate in practice; for spectrophotometry it is enough to know that it reads UV absorbance.

extra.zh: 酶活力单位有明确定义:1 U = 在规定条件下每分钟转化 1 μmol 底物;SI 单位 katal (kat) = 每秒 1 mol。比活力 specific activity = U / mg 蛋白,是纯化过程中判断纯度的关键指标。
extra.en: Enzyme activity has defined units: 1 U converts 1 μmol of substrate per minute under stated conditions; the SI unit katal (kat) is 1 mol per second. Specific activity = U per mg protein, the key purity readout during purification.

extra.zh: "单位时间的反应量"必须取初速度 initial velocity:一般要求底物消耗低于 5%,此时逆反应和产物抑制还可以忽略,速率与酶浓度成正比。
extra.en: The rate measured must be the initial velocity: keep substrate consumption under about 5%, where the back reaction and product inhibition are still negligible and the rate is proportional to enzyme concentration.

extra.zh: 酶加快反应是靠降低活化能 activation energy,同等地加快正逆两个方向;它不改变 ΔG,也不改变平衡常数 Keq,只让平衡更快达到。
extra.en: An enzyme accelerates a reaction by lowering the activation energy, speeding forward and reverse directions equally; it changes neither ΔG nor Keq, only how fast equilibrium is reached.

quiz.q_zh: 现在测定酶活性最常用的做法是什么?
quiz.q_en: How is enzyme activity most commonly measured today?

options.zh: 固定酶的量,测单位时间的反应量
options.en: Fix the enzyme amount, measure reaction per unit time

options.zh: 固定温度,测反应达到平衡的时间
options.en: Fix the temperature, time the approach to equilibrium

options.zh: 固定产物量,测所需要的酶浓度
options.en: Fix the product amount, measure the enzyme needed

options.zh: 固定底物量,测完全转化所需时间
options.en: Fix the substrate amount, time full conversion

quiz.explain_zh: 标准做法是固定酶量测单位时间的反应量,即反应速率。固定底物量测完全转化时间在原理上可行,但加酶会稀释体系、改变底物浓度,而且酶不改变平衡,"完全转化"常常达不到;以达平衡时间或以产物量反推酶浓度都不是酶活的定义。
quiz.explain_en: The standard assay fixes the enzyme and measures how much reaction occurs per unit time, i.e. the rate. Timing full conversion at fixed substrate is workable in principle but adding enzyme dilutes the system and shifts the substrate concentration, and since the enzyme does not move the equilibrium, full conversion often never occurs; timing the approach to equilibrium or back-calculating enzyme from product is not what activity means.

quiz.q_zh: 关于酶与反应平衡的关系,下列哪项正确?
quiz.q_en: Which statement about enzymes and equilibrium is correct?

options.zh: 降低活化能,同时提高平衡常数 Keq
options.en: Lowers the activation energy, raises Keq as well

options.zh: 提供反应能量,使平衡移向产物一侧
options.en: Supplies energy that shifts equilibrium to product

options.zh: 降低活化能,不改变平衡常数 Keq
options.en: Lowers the activation energy, leaves Keq unchanged

options.zh: 改变自由能变 ΔG,使反应更彻底
options.en: Changes ΔG so the reaction goes further to completion

quiz.explain_zh: 酶只降低活化能,正逆反应同等加速,平衡常数和 ΔG 都不变,只是更快到达平衡。说酶提高 Keq、提供反应能量推动平衡移向产物、或改变 ΔG 让反应更彻底,都违反热力学。
quiz.explain_en: An enzyme only lowers the activation energy, accelerating both directions equally; Keq and ΔG are unchanged and equilibrium is merely reached sooner. Claiming that it raises Keq, supplies energy to push the equilibrium toward product, or alters ΔG to drive the reaction further all violate thermodynamics.

title_zh: 分光光度法的局限与荧光法的高灵敏度
title_en: Limits of spectrophotometry versus the sensitivity of fluorescence

points.zh: 分光光度法 spectrophotometry 是靠测紫外吸收 UV absorbance 的变化来定量反应量的。
points.en: Spectrophotometry quantifies the reaction by following a change in UV absorbance.

points.zh: 它最大的缺点是所需体积大:要用比色皿 cuvette,一次取样最少约 1 mL。
points.en: Its big drawback is volume: it needs a cuvette, and one reading takes at least about 1 mL.

points.zh: 样品消耗量因此很大,而现在实验室常规操作只有几十到几百微升 μL,这种方法根本测不了。
points.en: That consumes a lot of sample, while typical modern reactions are only tens to hundreds of microlitres, which this method cannot handle.

points.zh: 现在用得比较多的是荧光法 fluorescence,它的特点是灵敏度非常非常高。
points.en: Fluorescence assays are now much more widely used, and their defining feature is extremely high sensitivity.

points.zh: 荧光本质上是把生物学过程放大:几皮克 pg、几纳克 ng 的产物变化就能被变成可见 visible 的信号。
points.en: Fluorescence amplifies the biological process: a change of picograms to nanograms of product is turned into a visible signal.

points.zh: 荧光信号受到的干扰一般也比较小,适合微量样品的连续监测。
points.en: Fluorescence signals also suffer relatively little interference, which suits continuous monitoring of small samples.

points.zh: 结论:实验上测酶活最常用的两类方法就是荧光法和同位素测定法。
points.en: Conclusion: the two methods actually used most in the lab are fluorescence and isotope assays.

extra.zh: 灵敏度差距是数量级级别的:吸收法的实用下限通常在 μM 量级,荧光法可以到 nM 甚至 pM。微孔板 microplate 荧光读数每孔只需 20–100 μL,正是它替代比色皿的原因。
extra.en: The sensitivity gap is orders of magnitude: absorbance assays are practically limited to the micromolar range, fluorescence reaches nanomolar or even picomolar. A microplate fluorescence read needs only 20-100 μL per well, which is exactly why it displaced the cuvette.

extra.zh: 分光光度法的经典用法是偶联测定 coupled assay,把反应连到 NAD(P)H 上,在 340 nm 读吸收,ε = 6220 M⁻¹cm⁻¹;定量依据是 Beer-Lambert 定律 A = εcl。
extra.en: The classic use of spectrophotometry is the coupled assay: link the reaction to NAD(P)H and read absorbance at 340 nm, where ε = 6220 M⁻¹cm⁻¹; quantification rests on the Beer-Lambert law A = εcl.

extra.zh: 荧光法灵敏但不是没有陷阱:底物或产物浓度过高会出现内滤效应 inner filter effect 和自淬灭,信号不再与浓度成正比,反而低估酶活。
extra.en: Fluorescence is sensitive but not trap-free: at high substrate or product concentration the inner filter effect and self-quenching make the signal non-linear and the activity is underestimated.

quiz.q_zh: 分光光度法测酶活的主要缺点是什么?
quiz.q_en: What is the main drawback of the spectrophotometric enzyme assay?

options.zh: 只适用于水解酶催化的反应
options.en: It applies only to hydrolase-catalysed reactions

options.zh: 只能读终点,无法连续监测反应
options.en: It reads endpoints only, never continuously

options.zh: 必须使用放射性标记的底物
options.en: It requires radioactively labelled substrate

options.zh: 比色皿体积大,样品消耗量多
options.en: Cuvettes need large volumes, consuming sample

quiz.explain_zh: 比色皿一次至少要 1 mL,而现在反应体系常常只有几十到几百微升,样品消耗是它被淘汰的主要原因。分光光度法恰恰是可以连续读数的,不需要放射性标记,也不限于水解酶。
quiz.explain_en: A cuvette needs at least about 1 mL per reading while modern reactions are tens to hundreds of microlitres, so sample consumption is what rules it out. Spectrophotometry is in fact a continuous readout, needs no radiolabel, and is not restricted to hydrolases.

quiz.q_zh: 荧光法相对于吸收法的核心优势是什么?
quiz.q_en: What is the core advantage of fluorescence over absorbance?

options.zh: 完全不受温度和 pH 的影响
options.en: Entirely insensitive to temperature and to pH

options.zh: 可以直接测出酶的分子量大小
options.en: It reports the enzyme's molecular mass directly

options.zh: 灵敏度高,微量产物即可检出
options.en: High sensitivity: trace product is detectable

options.zh: 无需任何仪器,肉眼即可判读
options.en: No instrument needed; readable by naked eye

quiz.explain_zh: 荧光把 pg–ng 级的产物变化放大成可见信号,灵敏度远高于吸收法。荧光仍然需要荧光计或酶标仪,荧光量子产率对温度和 pH 相当敏感,而分子量要靠 SDS-PAGE 或质谱测。
quiz.explain_en: Fluorescence amplifies picogram-to-nanogram changes of product into a visible signal, far beyond absorbance. It still needs a fluorimeter or plate reader, quantum yield is quite sensitive to temperature and pH, and molecular mass comes from SDS-PAGE or mass spectrometry.

title_zh: FRET 原理:荧光共振能量转移与猝灭基团
title_en: The FRET principle: resonance energy transfer and quenching

points.zh: FRET 的全称是 fluorescence resonance energy transfer,即荧光共振能量转移。
points.en: FRET stands for fluorescence resonance energy transfer.

points.zh: 拆开看:fluorescence 荧光、resonance 共振、energy transfer 能量转移。
points.en: Word by word: fluorescence, resonance, energy transfer.

points.zh: 化学上有一类小分子能发出荧光(供体 donor),另一类小分子能把荧光猝灭(猝灭基团 quencher)。
points.en: Chemistry provides small molecules that emit fluorescence (the donor) and others that quench it (the quencher).

points.zh: 当发光基团和猝灭基团结合、靠得很近时,发出的能量被猝灭基团接收,体系不再发荧光。
points.en: When emitter and quencher are joined and close together, the energy is taken up by the quencher and the system no longer fluoresces.

points.zh: 一旦两者远离,猝灭基团就没有办法再发挥作用,荧光随之恢复。
points.en: Once the two move apart, the quencher can no longer act and fluorescence is restored.

points.zh: 所以 FRET 读出的其实是两个基团之间的"距离":近则暗,远则亮。
points.en: FRET therefore reports the distance between the two groups: close means dark, far means bright.

points.zh: 任何能把这两个基团分开(或拉近)的生物学事件,都可以被转换成荧光信号。
points.en: Any biological event that separates or brings together those two groups can be converted into a fluorescence signal.

extra.zh: FRET 效率 E = 1/(1 + (r/R₀)⁶),对距离是六次方依赖。R₀(Förster 半径)通常 2–6 nm,有效工作范围约 1–10 nm,所以 FRET 被称作"分子尺"。
extra.en: FRET efficiency is E = 1/(1 + (r/R₀)⁶), a sixth-power distance dependence. R₀, the Förster radius, is typically 2-6 nm and the useful range is about 1-10 nm, which is why FRET is called a molecular ruler.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 严格的 FRET 不是"任意两个分子结合就猝灭":必须满足供体发射光谱与受体吸收光谱重叠 spectral overlap,且跃迁偶极取向合适。实际用的暗猝灭基团 dark quencher(Dabcyl、BHQ)吸能后以热的形式释放,自身不发光。
extra.en: Strict FRET is not "any two bound molecules quench each other": the donor emission spectrum must overlap the acceptor absorption spectrum, with suitable dipole orientation. The dark quenchers actually used (Dabcyl, BHQ) release the absorbed energy as heat and emit no light of their own.

extra.zh: FRET 是非辐射的共振能量转移,不是"供体先发光、受体再吸收";它也不同于直接接触猝灭 contact (static) quenching,后者要求两个基团形成非荧光复合物。
extra.en: FRET is non-radiative resonance transfer, not "the donor emits a photon and the acceptor absorbs it"; it also differs from contact (static) quenching, which requires the two groups to form a non-fluorescent complex.

quiz.q_zh: FRET 这个缩写的全称是什么?
quiz.q_en: What does the abbreviation FRET stand for?

options.zh: 荧光共振能量转移 (fluorescence resonance energy transfer)
options.en: Fluorescence resonance energy transfer

options.zh: 荧光恢复能量滴定 (fluorescence recovery energy titration)
options.en: Fluorescence recovery energy titration

options.zh: 荧光氧化还原发射跃迁 (fluorescence redox emission transition)
options.en: Fluorescence redox emission transition

options.zh: 荧光团反应平衡追踪 (fluorophore reaction equilibrium tracking)
options.en: Fluorophore reaction equilibrium tracking

quiz.explain_zh: F-R-E-T 分别是 fluorescence、resonance、energy、transfer,即荧光共振能量转移。写成 recovery、reaction 或 redox 的三个说法都不是这个术语;注意另有一个真实技术叫 FRAP(fluorescence recovery after photobleaching),与 FRET 不同。
quiz.explain_en: F-R-E-T expands to fluorescence, resonance, energy, transfer. The versions built on recovery, reaction or redox are not this term; note that a real but different technique, FRAP (fluorescence recovery after photobleaching), does exist.

quiz.q_zh: 决定 FRET 信号强弱的最关键因素是什么?
quiz.q_en: What most critically determines the FRET signal?

options.zh: 溶液中酶的总蛋白含量
options.en: The total enzyme protein in the solution

options.zh: 底物多肽的等电点 pI
options.en: The isoelectric point of the substrate

options.zh: 供体与受体之间的距离
options.en: The distance between donor and acceptor

options.zh: 反应体系的绝对温度高低
options.en: The absolute temperature of the system

quiz.explain_zh: 能量转移效率对供体—受体距离是六次方依赖,近则猝灭、远则发光,这正是 FRET 的读出原理。温度、酶的总量和底物的等电点都不决定能量转移本身是否发生。
quiz.explain_en: Transfer efficiency depends on the donor-acceptor distance to the sixth power: close means quenched, far means bright, and that is the readout. Temperature, total enzyme protein and the substrate's isoelectric point do not govern whether the transfer occurs.

title_zh: 用 FRET 底物测蛋白酶活性:A—多肽—B 的设计
title_en: Measuring protease activity with a FRET substrate

points.zh: 底物被设计成 A—多肽 peptide—B 的形式:A 是能发荧光的基团,B 是把荧光熄灭的猝灭基团。
points.en: The substrate is built as A-peptide-B: A is the fluorescent group and B is the quencher.

points.zh: 完整底物在溶液状态下,A 和 B 靠得很近,A 发出的荧光都被 B 熄灭,背景很低。
points.en: In the intact substrate in solution A and B are close, all of A's emission is quenched by B, and the background is low.

points.zh: 加入自己纯化的蛋白酶 protease,酶在中间的多肽上"切一刀"。
points.en: Adding a purified protease cuts the peptide in the middle.

points.zh: 切开之后溶液中形成游离的 A 和游离的 B,两者扩散分开。
points.en: Cleavage releases free A and free B, which diffuse apart.

points.zh: 游离的 A 重新发出荧光,B 再也不能把它熄灭,于是荧光强度上升。
points.en: Free A now fluoresces and B can no longer quench it, so the fluorescence rises.

points.zh: 检测这个荧光变化,就能测出酶的水解能力 hydrolytic activity。
points.en: Following that fluorescence change gives the enzyme's hydrolytic activity.

points.zh: 课上举的实例是测 SARS-CoV-2 的蛋白酶活性,用的就是这种 FRET 方法。
points.en: The worked example given is assaying a SARS-CoV-2 protease, done exactly with this FRET design.

points.zh: 这类基于荧光的蛋白酶测活方法在实验室里用得非常广泛。
points.en: Fluorescence-based protease assays of this kind are extremely widely used.

extra.zh: SARS-CoV-2 的主蛋白酶 Mpro(又称 3CLpro,nsp5)几乎绝对要求 P1 位是 Gln,在 Gln↓(Ser/Ala/Gly) 处切开;经典 FRET 底物是 Dabcyl-KTSAVLQ↓SGFRKM-Edans 一类,Edans 发光、Dabcyl 猝灭。
extra.en: The SARS-CoV-2 main protease Mpro (3CLpro, nsp5) almost absolutely requires Gln at P1 and cuts at Gln↓(Ser/Ala/Gly); the classic FRET substrate is of the Dabcyl-KTSAVLQ↓SGFRKM-Edans type, with Edans emitting and Dabcyl quenching.

extra.zh: 荧光读数是相对单位 RFU,要用完全切割的底物或产物标准品做标准曲线才能换算成 μmol/min;并且必须在初速度段、[S] 远低于 Km 时,速率才与酶浓度成正比。
extra.en: The readout is in relative fluorescence units; converting to μmol/min needs a standard curve from fully cleaved substrate or authentic product, and the rate is proportional to enzyme concentration only in the initial-velocity phase with [S] well below Km.

extra.zh: 猝灭不是把荧光基团破坏掉:切割前后 A 分子本身没变,变的只是它与 B 的距离。同理,底物浓度过高时未切割底物的吸收会造成内滤效应,使真实活性被低估。
extra.en: Quenching does not destroy the fluorophore: A itself is unchanged by cleavage, only its distance from B changes. Likewise, at high substrate concentration absorption by the uncleaved substrate causes an inner filter effect and underestimates the true activity.

quiz.q_zh: FRET 蛋白酶底物被切开后,荧光如何变化?
quiz.q_en: How does fluorescence change when a FRET protease substrate is cleaved?

options.zh: 不变,因为两个基团仍然相连
options.en: It is unchanged, because the pair stays linked

options.zh: 先增后减,因为产物重新结合
options.en: It rises then falls, as the products re-associate

options.zh: 增强,因为猝灭基团扩散离开
options.en: It rises, because the quencher diffuses away

options.zh: 减弱,因为发光基团随之降解
options.en: It falls, because the fluorophore is degraded

quiz.explain_zh: 切开多肽后游离的发光基团与猝灭基团扩散分开,距离超出能量转移范围,荧光恢复并随时间上升。发光基团本身并没有被降解,切开后两个基团也不再相连、不会自发重新结合。
quiz.explain_en: Cleaving the peptide lets the freed fluorophore and quencher diffuse apart beyond transfer range, so fluorescence recovers and climbs with time. The fluorophore itself is not degraded, and after cleavage the two groups are no longer linked and do not spontaneously re-associate.

quiz.q_zh: 课上举例用 FRET 方法测的是哪种酶?
quiz.q_en: Which enzyme was the lecture's FRET example?

options.zh: 酿酒酵母的己糖激酶
options.en: A yeast hexokinase enzyme

options.zh: SARS-CoV-2 蛋白酶
options.en: A SARS-CoV-2 protease

options.zh: 大肠杆菌的 DNA 聚合酶 I
options.en: An E. coli DNA polymerase I

options.zh: 线粒体的 ATP 合酶
options.en: A mitochondrial ATP synthase

quiz.explain_zh: 老师用 SARS-CoV-2 蛋白酶作例子,因为 FRET 底物天然适合测"切一刀"的水解反应。ATP 合酶、己糖激酶和 DNA 聚合酶都不是通过切开一段带双标记的多肽来读出的。
quiz.explain_en: The example given was a SARS-CoV-2 protease, because a FRET substrate naturally suits a hydrolytic single-cut reaction. ATP synthase, hexokinase and DNA polymerase are not read out by cleaving a doubly labelled peptide.

title_zh: 同位素测定法测酶活,并引出核酶
title_en: Isotope assays of enzyme activity, leading into ribozymes

points.zh: 另一类现在用得比较多的测酶活方法是同位素测定法 isotope assay。
points.en: The other widely used activity assay is the isotope assay.

points.zh: 它测的是同位素标记基团的转移 transfer:标记从供体分子转移到底物上。
points.en: It measures the transfer of an isotopically labelled group from a donor molecule onto the substrate.

points.zh: 最典型的应用是磷酸化 phosphorylation(激酶 kinase)和泛素化 ubiquitination 这类修饰反应。
points.en: The typical applications are modification reactions such as phosphorylation by kinases and ubiquitination.

points.zh: 同位素还常常配合成像 imaging 使用,可以做同位素成像读出。
points.en: Isotopes are often combined with imaging, giving an isotopic image as the readout.

points.zh: 荧光法和同位素测定法这两类,是实验上测酶活性用得最多的方法。
points.en: Fluorescence and isotope assays are the two methods used most in practice.

points.zh: 讲完通用测活方法后,课上专门提出一个特例:核酶 ribozyme。
points.en: After the general assay methods, the lecture singles out a special case: the ribozyme.

points.zh: 核酶的意义在于:催化活性不一定要来自蛋白质,一段 RNA 也可以发挥酶的功能。
points.en: The point of ribozymes is that catalytic activity need not come from protein: a stretch of RNA can act as an enzyme.

extra.zh: 激酶测活的经典试剂是 [γ-³²P]ATP:只有 γ 位磷酸被转移到底物上,α、β 位留在 ADP 里,所以标在 γ 位才有信号。³²P 半衰期 14.3 天,³H(12.3 年)和 ¹⁴C(5730 年)多用于代谢标记。
extra.en: The classic kinase reagent is [γ-³²P]ATP: only the γ-phosphate is transferred to the substrate while α and β stay with ADP, so the label must sit on γ. ³²P has a 14.3-day half-life, while ³H (12.3 y) and ¹⁴C (5730 y) are used for metabolic labelling.

extra.zh: 同位素法的优点是灵敏、不依赖底物的光学性质,几乎任何转移反应都能测;缺点是多为终点法 endpoint、需要分离结合与游离的标记(滤膜、SPA),并有放射防护和废物成本,所以逐渐被 ADP-Glo、荧光偏振等非放射方法取代。
extra.en: Isotope assays are sensitive and independent of the substrate's optical properties, so almost any transfer reaction can be measured; they are usually endpoint assays needing separation of bound from free label (filter binding, SPA) and carry radiation-safety and waste costs, so non-radioactive formats such as ADP-Glo or fluorescence polarisation increasingly replace them.

extra.zh: 同位素法读的是放射性计数 cpm/dpm,反映的是被转移的标记量,必须除以标记物的比活度 specific radioactivity 才能换算成物质的量,不能直接当作浓度读数。
extra.en: An isotope assay reads counts (cpm/dpm), reflecting how much label was transferred; you must divide by the tracer's specific radioactivity to get moles, and the counts are not a concentration readout.

quiz.q_zh: 同位素测定法最常用于哪一类反应?
quiz.q_en: Which class of reaction do isotope assays serve best?

options.zh: 膜蛋白在脂双层中的横向扩散
options.en: Lateral diffusion of proteins in the bilayer

options.zh: 抗原与抗体之间的特异性结合
options.en: Specific binding between antigen and antibody

options.zh: 蛋白质的可逆变性与复性过程
options.en: Reversible denaturation and refolding of protein

options.zh: 磷酸化、泛素化等基团转移
options.en: Group transfer: phosphorylation, ubiquitination

quiz.explain_zh: 同位素法测的正是被转移的标记基团,所以最适合激酶的磷酸化和泛素化这类转移反应。抗原抗体结合、蛋白质变性复性、膜内扩散都不涉及可追踪的基团转移,分别用 ELISA/SPR、CD 或圆二色、FRAP 来测。
quiz.explain_en: The isotope assay counts a transferred labelled group, which is exactly what kinase phosphorylation and ubiquitination provide. Antigen-antibody binding, denaturation and refolding, and diffusion in a membrane involve no traceable group transfer and are measured by ELISA/SPR, CD spectroscopy and FRAP respectively.

quiz.q_zh: 激酶活性测定常用哪种放射性标记的 ATP?
quiz.q_en: Which labelled ATP is standard for kinase assays?

options.zh: [β-³²P]ATP,β 位磷被转移
options.en: [β-³²P]ATP; the β phosphate transfers

options.zh: [γ-³²P]ATP,γ 位磷被转移
options.en: [γ-³²P]ATP; the γ phosphate transfers

options.zh: [α-³²P]ATP,α 位磷被转移
options.en: [α-³²P]ATP; the α phosphate transfers

options.zh: [³H]ATP,腺嘌呤上氢被转移
options.en: [³H]ATP; a hydrogen on adenine transfers

quiz.explain_zh: 激酶转移的是 ATP 末端的 γ-磷酸,所以只有标在 γ 位的 ATP 才会把放射性带到底物上;α 位和 β 位的磷酸留在 ADP 中,腺嘌呤上的氢根本不参与转移。
quiz.explain_en: A kinase transfers the terminal γ-phosphate of ATP, so only a γ-labelled ATP carries radioactivity onto the substrate; the α and β phosphates stay in ADP, and hydrogen on the adenine is not transferred at all.

title_zh: 核酶的发现与酶学特性,兼谈抗体酶
title_en: Discovery and enzymology of ribozymes, plus abzymes

points.zh: 核酶最早发现于四膜虫 Tetrahymena 这种单细胞生物。
points.en: Ribozymes were first found in the single-celled organism Tetrahymena.

points.zh: 观察到的现象是:它的 26S rRNA 在成熟过程中,RNA 上的内含子 intron 会被剪切去除。
points.en: The observation was that during maturation of its 26S rRNA, an intron in the RNA is spliced out.

points.zh: 关键发现是这段 RNA 自己就具有把自身内含子去除的功能,不需要蛋白质酶,即自剪接 self-splicing。
points.en: The key finding was that the RNA itself removes its own intron without any protein enzyme: self-splicing.

points.zh: 因为它就是一段 RNA 却能发挥酶的活性,人们把这类分子命名为核酶 ribozyme。
points.en: Because it is simply a stretch of RNA that nonetheless acts as an enzyme, such molecules were named ribozymes.

points.zh: 核酶具有经典酶促反应的特征:它的底物也是高度专一的 substrate specificity。
points.en: Ribozymes show the classic hallmarks of enzyme catalysis: their substrates are highly specific.

points.zh: 核酶的催化同样符合米氏方程 Michaelis-Menten equation。
points.en: Ribozyme catalysis likewise obeys the Michaelis-Menten equation.

points.zh: 核酶也像正常的蛋白酶一样会被竞争性抑制 competitive inhibition,对抑制剂敏感。
points.en: Ribozymes are also subject to competitive inhibition and are sensitive to inhibitors, just as protein enzymes are.

points.zh: 抗体酶 abzyme:抗体分为恒定区和可变区 variable region,可变区由不同基因片段随机组合产生。
points.en: Abzymes: antibodies have a constant and a variable region, and the variable region is generated by random combination of gene segments.

points.zh: 随机组合中不可避免会出现某些序列恰好具有酶活性,这类抗体就叫抗体酶;课上认为这部分不太重要。
points.en: Some of those random combinations inevitably happen to have catalytic activity, and such antibodies are called abzymes; the lecture treats this as a minor point.

extra.zh: 四膜虫 Tetrahymena thermophila 不是原核生物,而是单细胞真核生物(纤毛虫原生动物)。这一点很关键:正因为它是真核生物,它的 rRNA 前体里才有内含子需要剪接;细菌的核糖体 RNA 通常没有这种内含子。
extra.en: Tetrahymena thermophila is not a prokaryote but a single-celled eukaryote, a ciliate protozoan. This matters: precisely because it is eukaryotic its rRNA precursor carries an intron to be spliced, whereas bacterial ribosomal RNA generally does not.

extra.zh: Thomas Cech(四膜虫 group I 内含子自剪接)与 Sidney Altman(RNase P 中真正起催化作用的是其 RNA 亚基 M1 RNA)因发现 RNA 的催化活性共获 1989 年诺贝尔化学奖。另一个重量级核酶是核糖体本身:肽键形成的肽基转移酶中心 peptidyl transferase center 完全由 23S/28S rRNA 构成。
extra.en: Thomas Cech (self-splicing of the Tetrahymena group I intron) and Sidney Altman (the catalytic subunit of RNase P is its M1 RNA) shared the 1989 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for discovering catalytic RNA. The other headline ribozyme is the ribosome itself: the peptidyl transferase centre that forms peptide bonds is built entirely of 23S/28S rRNA.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 核酶并不是"能催化任何化学反应"。天然核酶的反应谱很窄,主要是磷酸二酯键的转酯与水解(group I/II 内含子自剪接、hammerhead 和 hairpin 核酶、RNase P),外加核糖体催化的肽键形成;催化效率一般也低于同类蛋白酶。
extra.en: Ribozymes do not catalyse "any reaction". Natural ribozymes have a narrow repertoire, essentially transesterification and hydrolysis of phosphodiester bonds (group I/II intron self-splicing, hammerhead and hairpin ribozymes, RNase P), plus peptide-bond formation by the ribosome; their rates are generally below those of comparable protein enzymes.

extra.zh: 抗体酶不只是碰巧出现的:实验上用过渡态类似物 transition-state analog 作为半抗原免疫,可以定向筛出结合过渡态的抗体,从而获得催化活性——这直接印证了"酶催化的本质是稳定过渡态"。其催化效率通常比天然酶低几个数量级。
extra.en: Abzymes are not only accidental: immunising with a transition-state analogue as hapten selects antibodies that bind the transition state and thereby acquire catalytic activity, a direct demonstration that catalysis works by stabilising the transition state. Their rates are usually orders of magnitude below natural enzymes.

quiz.q_zh: 核酶最早是在哪种生物的哪种 RNA 中发现的?
quiz.q_en: In which organism and RNA were ribozymes first found?

options.zh: 四膜虫的 26S rRNA 前体
options.en: The 26S rRNA precursor of Tetrahymena

options.zh: 酿酒酵母的 tRNA-Phe 前体
options.en: The tRNA-Phe precursor of budding yeast

options.zh: T4 噬菌体的 mRNA 前体
options.en: The mRNA precursor of bacteriophage T4

options.zh: 大肠杆菌的 16S rRNA 前体
options.en: The 16S rRNA precursor of E. coli

quiz.explain_zh: 最早的核酶来自四膜虫 26S rRNA 前体中的内含子,它能自我剪接把自己切除。大肠杆菌 16S rRNA 前体的加工靠蛋白质核酸酶,酵母 tRNA-Phe 是经典的晶体结构材料而非自剪接例子,T4 噬菌体虽含 group I 内含子但不是核酶的首次发现。
quiz.explain_en: The first ribozyme was the intron in the Tetrahymena 26S rRNA precursor, which excises itself by self-splicing. Processing of the E. coli 16S rRNA precursor relies on protein nucleases, yeast tRNA-Phe is famous for its crystal structure rather than self-splicing, and although phage T4 does carry group I introns it was not the original discovery.

quiz.q_zh: 关于核酶的酶学性质,下列哪项正确?
quiz.q_en: Which statement about ribozyme enzymology is correct?

options.zh: 无底物专一性,不符合米氏方程动力学
options.en: Not substrate-specific and disobeys Michaelis-Menten

options.zh: 有底物专一性,但不被任何抑制剂抑制
options.en: Substrate-specific, yet insensitive to all inhibitors

options.zh: 无底物专一性,催化时需蛋白质酶辅助
options.en: Not substrate-specific, needs a protein enzyme to work

options.zh: 有底物专一性,动力学符合米氏方程
options.en: Substrate-specific and obeys Michaelis-Menten kinetics

quiz.explain_zh: 核酶表现出经典酶促反应特征:底物高度专一,动力学符合米氏方程,而且会被竞争性抑制。说它不专一、不符合米氏方程,或说它不受任何抑制剂影响,都与观察相反;自剪接内含子恰恰证明它不需要蛋白质酶帮忙。
quiz.explain_en: Ribozymes show the classic hallmarks: high substrate specificity, Michaelis-Menten kinetics, and susceptibility to competitive inhibition. Saying they lack specificity or depart from Michaelis-Menten, or that no inhibitor affects them, contradicts the observations; and self-splicing introns are the very demonstration that no protein enzyme is required.

quiz.q_zh: 抗体酶 abzyme 的催化活性来自抗体的哪一部分?
quiz.q_en: Which part of an antibody carries abzyme catalytic activity?

options.zh: 轻链与重链之间的二硫键
options.en: Disulfide bonds between the two chain types

options.zh: 与补体结合之后的构象变化
options.en: Conformation formed after complement binding

options.zh: 可变区随机组合产生的序列
options.en: Random combinations in the variable region

options.zh: 恒定区上携带的糖基化修饰
options.en: Glycosylation carried on the constant region

quiz.explain_zh: 可变区由基因片段随机组合而成,少数组合恰好形成了能催化反应的结合口袋,这就是抗体酶。恒定区的糖基化决定的是效应功能,链间二硫键只维持四链结构,补体结合发生在恒定区且与催化无关。
quiz.explain_en: The variable region arises from random combination of gene segments, and a few combinations happen to form a pocket that catalyses a reaction: that is an abzyme. Constant-region glycosylation governs effector function, interchain disulfides merely hold the four chains together, and complement binds the constant region with no bearing on catalysis.

title_zh: 收尾抗体酶，转入米氏方程：酶促反应动力学的 v–[S] 作图
title_en: Wrapping up abzymes, entering Michaelis-Menten: the v vs [S] plot

points.zh: 抗体酶 abzyme 到此为止：实际上基本见不到，只是一种分类概念，不作为重点。
points.en: Abzymes are wrapped up here: they are essentially never encountered in practice and amount to a classification label only, not an exam focus.

points.zh: 本节安排：把米氏方程 Michaelis-Menten equation 的推导讲完；作图留到下次课。
points.en: Plan for this session: finish the derivation of the Michaelis-Menten equation; the plotting is deferred to the next session.

points.zh: 作图之所以留到下次，是因为要和抑制作用 inhibition 一起讲——不同类型的抑制会改变图形。
points.en: Plotting is deferred because it has to be taught together with inhibition: different inhibition types change the shape of the plot.

points.zh: 米氏方程属于酶促反应动力学 enzyme kinetics 的内容，描述速率如何随底物浓度变化。
points.en: The Michaelis-Menten equation belongs to enzyme kinetics: it describes how rate changes with substrate concentration.

points.zh: 基本实验设计：把酶加入一个反应体系，酶量保持不变，只不断改变底物浓度 [S]。
points.en: Basic experimental design: add enzyme to a reaction system, keep the amount of enzyme fixed, and vary only the substrate concentration [S].

points.zh: 标准作图：纵坐标是反应速率 v，横坐标是底物浓度 [S]。
points.en: Standard plot: reaction rate v on the y-axis, substrate concentration [S] on the x-axis.

points.zh: 随 [S] 升高，曲线呈三段式趋势：先与 [S] 成正比上升，再增幅变缓，最后达到最大值不再上升。
points.en: As [S] rises the curve shows three phases: an initial rise proportional to [S], then a flattening rise, and finally a plateau where it no longer increases.

extra.zh: 这条曲线在数学上是直角双曲线 rectangular hyperbola，方程 v = Vmax[S]/(Km + [S])，由 Vmax 与 Km 两个参数完全决定。
extra.en: Mathematically the curve is a rectangular hyperbola, v = Vmax[S]/(Km + [S]), fully specified by just two parameters, Vmax and Km.

extra.zh: 纵轴的 v 必须是初速度 initial velocity v0：反应刚开始、产物接近于零、底物消耗很少时的速率。否则底物耗竭和产物抑制会把曲线压低。
extra.en: The v on the y-axis must be the initial velocity v0, measured at the very start when product is near zero and little substrate has been consumed; otherwise substrate depletion and product inhibition distort the curve.

extra.zh: v–[S] 曲线（每个点是一次独立实验的初速度）与反应进程曲线 progress curve（同一次反应中产物随时间累积）是两张完全不同的图。
extra.en: The v vs [S] curve, where each point is the initial velocity of a separate experiment, is a different plot from the progress curve, which follows product accumulating over time in one reaction.

extra.zh: 下次课要讲的作图，通常指 Lineweaver-Burk 双倒数作图（1/v 对 1/[S]）以及 Eadie-Hofstee、Hanes-Woolf 等线性化方法。
extra.en: The plotting promised for next time normally means the Lineweaver-Burk double-reciprocal plot (1/v against 1/[S]) plus linearisations such as Eadie-Hofstee and Hanes-Woolf.

quiz.q_zh: 米氏动力学的标准曲线中，横轴和纵轴分别是什么？
quiz.q_en: In the standard Michaelis-Menten plot, what are the x- and y-axes?

options.zh: 横轴底物浓度，纵轴反应速率
options.en: x: substrate concentration, y: reaction rate

options.zh: 横轴反应时间，纵轴产物浓度
options.en: x: reaction time, y: product concentration

options.zh: 横轴酶的浓度，纵轴底物浓度
options.en: x: enzyme concentration, y: substrate concentration

options.zh: 横轴反应速率，纵轴底物浓度
options.en: x: reaction rate, y: substrate concentration

quiz.explain_zh: 课上明确说纵坐标是反应速率、横坐标是底物浓度。以时间为横轴、产物为纵轴的那一项画的是反应进程曲线，不是米氏曲线；把速率放在横轴的那一项把两轴写反了。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture states plainly that rate is on the y-axis and substrate concentration on the x-axis. Time against product describes a progress curve, not the Michaelis-Menten plot, and putting rate on the x-axis simply swaps the two axes.

quiz.q_zh: 酶促反应动力学为什么要测初速度 v0？
quiz.q_en: Why is enzyme kinetics measured as an initial velocity v0?

options.zh: 此时酶浓度会随时间而升高
options.en: the enzyme concentration rises with time

options.zh: 此时产物极少，逆反应可忽略
options.en: product is negligible, so no back-reaction

options.zh: 此时酶还完全没有结合底物
options.en: the enzyme has not bound any substrate yet

options.zh: 此时底物已经基本被消耗完
options.en: the substrate has almost all been consumed

quiz.explain_zh: 初速度阶段产物浓度接近零，E + P 重新结合的逆反应可以忽略，底物浓度也还等于加入值。说酶尚未结合底物则速率为零，无从测量；底物耗尽和酶浓度升高都不符合实验条件。
quiz.explain_en: At the initial-rate stage product is close to zero, so the E + P back-reaction is negligible and [S] still equals what was added. If the enzyme had bound nothing the rate would be zero and unmeasurable, while substrate exhaustion and a rising enzyme concentration both contradict the experimental setup.

quiz.q_zh: 固定酶量、逐步提高底物浓度，反应速率的整体变化趋势是？
quiz.q_en: With enzyme fixed and substrate raised step by step, how does the rate behave overall?

options.zh: 自始至终与底物浓度严格成正比
options.en: strictly proportional to substrate throughout

options.zh: 自始至终与底物浓度完全无关
options.en: entirely independent of substrate throughout

options.zh: 先与底物浓度成正比，后趋于恒定
options.en: first proportional to substrate, then levelling off

options.zh: 先趋于恒定，后与底物浓度成正比
options.en: first levelling off, then proportional to substrate

quiz.explain_zh: 低底物浓度时速率与 [S] 成正比，随后增幅递减，最终酶被饱和、速率不再随 [S] 变化。始终成正比意味着速率无上限；始终无关则否定了低浓度区的线性段。
quiz.explain_en: At low [S] the rate is proportional to [S], the increase then tapers off, and finally the enzyme saturates and the rate stops responding to [S]. Strict proportionality throughout would imply an unbounded rate, while complete independence denies the linear region at low [S].

title_zh: 低底物浓度区：速率与 [S] 成正比的一级反应
title_en: Low substrate concentration: the first-order region where v is proportional to [S]

points.zh: 低底物浓度时，反应速率与底物浓度成正比：有多少底物就转化多少。
points.en: At low substrate concentration the rate is proportional to [S]: whatever substrate is present gets turned over.

points.zh: 课上的直观解释是此时酶的催化能力大量空闲，底物一来就被结合并转化掉。
points.en: The lecture's intuitive account is that most of the enzyme's catalytic capacity sits idle, so any substrate arriving is bound and converted at once.

points.zh: 这一段称为一级反应 first-order reaction。
points.en: This stretch is called a first-order reaction.

points.zh: 一级反应的数学形式是 y = kx，即一条过原点的直线，k 为该条件下的速率常数。
points.en: A first-order reaction has the form y = kx, a straight line through the origin whose slope k is the rate constant under those conditions.

points.zh: 所谓反应的级数，看的是速率对底物浓度的依赖次方：一级即 [S] 的一次方。
points.en: The order of the reaction refers to the power of substrate concentration the rate depends on: first order means [S] to the first power.

points.zh: 底物浓度继续升高后，速率仍然增加，但不再与 [S] 成正比，线性关系逐渐消失。
points.en: As substrate is raised further the rate still increases but is no longer proportional to [S], and the linear relationship gradually disappears.

points.zh: 这一非线性过渡区的本质，是体系在逐渐趋近于酶被底物饱和的状态。
points.en: This non-linear transition region reflects the system gradually approaching saturation of the enzyme by substrate.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 一级反应区的判据是 [S] 远小于 Km，而不是酶与底物的摩尔比 1:1。典型实验中酶是 nM 级、Km 是 μM–mM 级，所以底物早已远多于酶，反应仍然是一级。
extra.en: The criterion for the first-order region is [S] far below Km, not a 1:1 molar ratio of enzyme to substrate. In a typical assay enzyme is nanomolar while Km is micromolar to millimolar, so substrate already far exceeds enzyme and the reaction is still first order.

extra.zh: 当 [S] 远小于 Km 时，米氏方程退化为 v ≈ (Vmax/Km)[S]，因此直线斜率是 Vmax/Km，对应的表观一级速率常数等于 (kcat/Km)·[E]t。
extra.en: When [S] is far below Km the Michaelis-Menten equation collapses to v ≈ (Vmax/Km)[S], so the slope is Vmax/Km and the apparent first-order rate constant equals (kcat/Km) times total enzyme.

extra.zh: 这里的一级只是对底物而言，严格说是准一级 pseudo-first-order（因为酶浓度固定）；反应速率对酶浓度在任何 [S] 下都是一级。
extra.en: First order here refers to substrate only, and strictly it is pseudo-first-order because enzyme is held constant; with respect to enzyme concentration the rate is first order at any [S].

quiz.q_zh: 反应速率与底物浓度成正比（一级反应区）的条件是？
quiz.q_en: What condition puts the reaction in the first-order region, with rate proportional to [S]?

options.zh: 底物浓度正好等于 Km
options.en: substrate concentration exactly equal to Km

options.zh: 酶的浓度远大于 Km
options.en: enzyme concentration far above Km

options.zh: 底物浓度远小于 Km
options.en: substrate concentration far below Km

options.zh: 底物浓度远大于 Km
options.en: substrate concentration far above Km

quiz.explain_zh: [S] 远小于 Km 时 v ≈ (Vmax/Km)[S]，成正比。[S] 远大于 Km 是饱和的零级区；[S] 等于 Km 时速率为 Vmax 的一半，正处于曲线弯曲处；酶浓度与 Km 不是同一类量，不能这样比较。
quiz.explain_en: With [S] far below Km, v approximates (Vmax/Km)[S] and is proportional to [S]. Far above Km is the saturated zero-order region; at [S] equal to Km the rate is half Vmax, right in the bend of the curve; and enzyme concentration is not the quantity Km compares against.

quiz.q_zh: 在 [S] 远小于 Km 的区间，v 对 [S] 作图的直线斜率等于？
quiz.q_en: In the region where [S] is far below Km, what is the slope of v plotted against [S]?

options.zh: Vmax/Km
options.en: Vmax/Km

options.zh: Km/Vmax
options.en: Km/Vmax

options.zh: Vmax×Km
options.en: Vmax×Km

options.zh: Vmax−Km
options.en: Vmax−Km

quiz.explain_zh: 把 [S] 远小于 Km 代入 v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S])，分母近似为 Km，得 v ≈ (Vmax/Km)[S]。Km/Vmax 是它的倒数，乘积与差值都没有动力学含义。
quiz.explain_en: Substituting [S] far below Km into v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S]) makes the denominator approximately Km, giving v ≈ (Vmax/Km)[S]. Km/Vmax is its reciprocal, and neither the product nor the difference has kinetic meaning.

quiz.q_zh: 所谓一级反应、零级反应中的级，指的是什么？
quiz.q_en: In the terms first-order and zero-order reaction, what does the order refer to?

options.zh: 反应过程中出现的中间体数
options.en: the number of intermediates along the pathway

options.zh: 速率所依赖的底物浓度次方
options.en: the exponent of [S] in the rate equation

options.zh: 酶催化反应所经历的步骤数
options.en: the number of steps in the catalysed reaction

options.zh: 酶结合底物所用的位点数目
options.en: the number of sites the enzyme uses to bind

quiz.explain_zh: 级数是速率方程中浓度项的指数：一级为 [S] 的一次方（y = kx），零级为 [S] 的零次方（y = 常数）。步骤数、结合位点数和中间体数都属于机制描述，与级数无关。
quiz.explain_en: Order is the exponent on the concentration term in the rate law: first order is [S] to the power one (y = kx), zero order is [S] to the power zero (y = constant). Step counts, binding sites and intermediates describe mechanism, not order.

title_zh: 过渡区到零级反应：底物饱和与 Vmax
title_en: From the transition region to zero order: substrate saturation and Vmax

points.zh: 中间过渡区：底物继续增加时速率仍上升，但增幅递减，不再是线性关系。
points.en: In the intermediate region more substrate still raises the rate, but by ever smaller increments, and the relationship is no longer linear.

points.zh: 过渡区的物理含义是酶正在被逐步占满，越来越接近饱和。
points.en: Physically the transition region means the enzyme is being progressively occupied and approaching saturation.

points.zh: 当底物浓度远远大于酶浓度、达到一定值后，反应速率达到最大值 Vmax。
points.en: Once substrate concentration greatly exceeds enzyme and passes a certain level, the rate reaches its maximum, Vmax.

points.zh: 此时无论怎样继续加底物，速率都不再增加——酶被饱和。
points.en: From then on adding more substrate no longer increases the rate: the enzyme is saturated.

points.zh: 这一段称为零级反应 zero-order reaction：速率与底物浓度无关。
points.en: This stretch is the zero-order reaction: the rate is independent of substrate concentration.

points.zh: 零级的数学形式是 y = c，即常数；相当于 [S] 的零次方，方程里已经没有 x 了。
points.en: Zero order has the form y = c, a constant; it corresponds to [S] to the power zero, so the variable drops out of the equation.

points.zh: 录音中出现的“临近对饱和了0”是口播含混，意思是接近饱和、进入零级反应。
points.en: The garbled phrase in the recording about saturation and zero simply means the system nears saturation and enters zero-order kinetics.

extra.zh: Vmax = kcat × [E]t。零级只是对底物而言：Vmax 本身与总酶浓度成正比，加倍酶量就把平台抬高一倍。
extra.en: Vmax equals kcat times total enzyme. Zero order applies to substrate only: Vmax itself is proportional to total enzyme, so doubling the enzyme doubles the plateau.

extra.zh: 曲线的半饱和点定义了 Km：当 [S] = Km 时 v = Vmax/2。Km 的量纲是浓度，不是速率。
extra.en: The half-saturation point defines Km: when [S] equals Km, v is Vmax/2. Km has units of concentration, not of rate.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 进入饱和的判据是 [S] 远大于 Km，而不是 [S] 远大于 [E]。实践中常取 [S] ≈ 10×Km，此时速率约为 Vmax 的 91%。
extra.en: Saturation is set by [S] far above Km rather than [S] far above [E]. In practice one uses [S] around ten times Km, which gives roughly 91 percent of Vmax.

extra.zh: 双曲线只是渐近趋近 Vmax，严格说永远达不到，所以 Vmax 是外推值；直接从曲线上目测最高点会系统性低估 Vmax，这正是后面要用双倒数作图的原因。
extra.en: The hyperbola only approaches Vmax asymptotically and never strictly reaches it, so Vmax is an extrapolated value; reading the highest point off the curve by eye underestimates it systematically, which is exactly why double-reciprocal plots are introduced later.

quiz.q_zh: 零级反应区的特征是？
quiz.q_en: What characterises the zero-order region?

options.zh: 速率与底物浓度成正比上升
options.en: the rate rises in proportion to substrate

options.zh: 速率与酶的总浓度成反比
options.en: the rate is inversely related to total enzyme

options.zh: 速率随底物浓度升高而下降
options.en: the rate falls as substrate concentration rises

options.zh: 速率恒定，与底物浓度无关
options.en: the rate is constant, independent of [S]

quiz.explain_zh: 零级即 v = 常数 = Vmax，与 [S] 无关。与 [S] 成正比是低浓度的一级区；速率与总酶量是正比而非反比；底物升高使速率下降属于底物抑制，是另一种特殊现象。
quiz.explain_en: Zero order means v equals a constant, Vmax, independent of [S]. Proportionality to [S] describes the first-order region at low substrate; rate scales with total enzyme directly rather than inversely; and a rate that falls with rising substrate is substrate inhibition, a separate special case.

quiz.q_zh: 当底物浓度恰好等于 Km 时，反应速率是多少？
quiz.q_en: What is the reaction rate when substrate concentration equals Km?

options.zh: Vmax 的两倍
options.en: twice Vmax

options.zh: Vmax 本身
options.en: Vmax itself

options.zh: Vmax 的十分之一
options.en: one tenth of Vmax

options.zh: Vmax 的一半
options.en: half of Vmax

quiz.explain_zh: 代入 v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S])，当 [S] = Km 时分子分母之比为 1/2。速率不可能超过 Vmax，所以两倍不成立；等于 Vmax 需要 [S] 远大于 Km；十分之一对应 [S] 约为 Km/9。
quiz.explain_en: Substituting [S] equal to Km into v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S]) gives one half. The rate can never exceed Vmax, so twice is impossible; reaching Vmax requires [S] far above Km; and one tenth corresponds to [S] near Km/9.

quiz.q_zh: 反应速率达到 Vmax 时，酶主要以什么形式存在？
quiz.q_en: When the rate reaches Vmax, in what form is most of the enzyme?

options.zh: 几乎全部是 ES 复合物
options.en: almost all as the ES complex

options.zh: 几乎全部是游离的酶 E
options.en: almost all as free enzyme E

options.zh: 一半 ES、一半游离酶
options.en: half ES and half free enzyme

options.zh: 几乎全部是变性失活的酶
options.en: almost all as denatured enzyme

quiz.explain_zh: 饱和意味着几乎所有活性位点都被底物占据，酶几乎全部以 ES 形式存在，因此再加底物也无处可结合。游离酶占多数对应低底物浓度；ES 与游离酶各半对应 [S] = Km；高底物浓度并不会使酶变性。
quiz.explain_en: Saturation means nearly every active site is occupied, so the enzyme exists almost entirely as ES and extra substrate has nowhere to bind. Mostly free enzyme describes low substrate; an even split of ES and free enzyme corresponds to [S] equal to Km; and high substrate does not denature the enzyme.

title_zh: 用饱和条件测 Vmax，以及经典反应式 E + S ⇌ ES → E + P
title_en: Measuring Vmax under saturation, and the classic scheme E + S ⇌ ES → E + P

points.zh: 测一个酶的速率时，通常刻意选第三种情况：让底物浓度远远大于酶浓度。
points.en: To measure an enzyme's rate one deliberately chooses the third case: substrate concentration far greater than enzyme concentration.

points.zh: 理由是在饱和条件下测到的是 Vmax，课上认为它最能反映这个酶的活性。
points.en: The reason is that saturating conditions give Vmax, which the lecture takes as the best reflection of the enzyme's activity.

points.zh: 推导前先约定符号：S 代表 substrate 底物，E 代表 enzyme 酶，米氏方程中一律如此。
points.en: Before the derivation the symbols are fixed: S is substrate and E is enzyme throughout the Michaelis-Menten treatment.

points.zh: 最早建立的反应式是两步：底物与酶先以一定速率结合成 ES 复合体。
points.en: The earliest scheme has two steps: substrate and enzyme first combine at a certain rate to form the ES complex.

points.zh: ES 复合体就是酶和底物结合在一起的中间物种，课上称之为过渡态过程。
points.en: The ES complex is the species in which enzyme and substrate are bound together, which the lecture calls a transition-state process.

points.zh: ES 又以一定速率分解，生成产物 P（product），同时把酶重新释放出来。
points.en: ES then breaks down at a certain rate to give product P while releasing the enzyme again.

points.zh: 酶被释放后可以再次进入循环，这就是经典的酶促反应过程。
points.en: The released enzyme re-enters the cycle, and this is the classic enzyme-catalysed reaction scheme.

extra.zh: ES 是基态的酶–底物复合物（Michaelis complex），处在能量低谷，不是过渡态。真正的过渡态写作 ES‡，处于能垒顶端；酶的催化本质是稳定 ES‡、降低活化能。
extra.en: ES is the ground-state enzyme-substrate complex, the Michaelis complex, sitting in an energy well; it is not the transition state. The true transition state is written ES double-dagger at the top of the barrier, and catalysis works by stabilising it and lowering the activation energy.

extra.zh: Vmax 随加入的酶量而变，不能用来横向比较两种酶。描述酶本身的是 kcat = Vmax/[E]t（转换数 turnover number，单位 s⁻¹），比较催化效率则用 kcat/Km。
extra.en: Vmax scales with how much enzyme was added and cannot compare two enzymes. The enzyme-intrinsic constant is kcat = Vmax/[E]t, the turnover number in per-second units, and catalytic efficiency is compared by kcat/Km.

extra.zh: 酶活力单位：1 U = 每分钟转化 1 μmol 底物；SI 单位 katal = 每秒 1 mol。比活力 specific activity = U/mg 蛋白，用来衡量纯度。
extra.en: Activity units: one U converts one micromole of substrate per minute, while the SI katal is one mole per second. Specific activity, U per milligram of protein, tracks purity.

quiz.q_zh: 要比较两种酶本身的催化能力，最合适的参数是？
quiz.q_en: Which parameter best compares the intrinsic catalytic power of two enzymes?

options.zh: ΔG，反应自由能
options.en: ΔG, the free-energy change

options.zh: kcat，转换数
options.en: kcat, the turnover number

options.zh: Vmax，最大速率
options.en: Vmax, the maximal rate

options.zh: [E]t，总酶浓度
options.en: [E]t, total enzyme

quiz.explain_zh: kcat = Vmax/[E]t，已经除掉了酶量，是酶分子本身每秒的转换次数。Vmax 随加入的酶量而变；总酶浓度只是实验用量；反应自由能由底物与产物决定，与催化剂无关。
quiz.explain_en: kcat equals Vmax divided by total enzyme, so the amount of enzyme is divided out and what remains is turnovers per second per molecule. Vmax depends on how much enzyme was added, total enzyme is merely the amount used, and the free-energy change is set by substrate and product regardless of catalyst.

quiz.q_zh: 在反应能量图上，ES 复合物属于什么？
quiz.q_en: On the reaction energy diagram, what is the ES complex?

options.zh: 酶失去活性的变性状态
options.en: the denatured, inactive state of the enzyme

options.zh: 能量较低的基态中间物
options.en: a ground-state intermediate in an energy well

options.zh: 能量最高的过渡态结构
options.en: the highest-energy transition-state structure

options.zh: 反应结束时的最终产物
options.en: the final product at the end of the reaction

quiz.explain_zh: ES 是能量低谷中的稳定中间物；能垒顶端的是 ES‡ 过渡态，酶正是靠稳定它来降低活化能。最终产物是 P 加游离酶；变性态与催化机制无关。
quiz.explain_en: ES is a stable intermediate in an energy well, whereas the species at the top of the barrier is the transition state ES double-dagger, which the enzyme stabilises to lower the activation energy. The final product is P plus free enzyme, and the denatured state has nothing to do with the mechanism.

quiz.q_zh: 经典反应式 E + S ⇌ ES → E + P 的最后一步同时生成什么？
quiz.q_en: In the classic scheme E + S ⇌ ES → E + P, what does the last step release?

options.zh: 产物和 ES 复合物
options.en: the product and the ES complex

options.zh: 产物和游离的酶
options.en: the product and the free enzyme

options.zh: 产物和游离底物
options.en: the product and free substrate

options.zh: 底物和游离的酶
options.en: the substrate and the free enzyme

quiz.explain_zh: ES 分解为 P 与 E，酶被释放后可再次结合底物，这是酶作为催化剂反复使用的基础。释放底物那两项描述的是 ES 逆向解离；ES 是被消耗的反应物，不会与产物一同生成。
quiz.explain_en: ES breaks down into P and E, and the released enzyme can bind substrate again, which is why a catalyst is reusable. The options releasing substrate describe the reverse dissociation of ES, and ES is consumed in this step rather than produced alongside the product.

title_zh: 完善版反应式与四个速率常数 k1–k4，实验实测的是 k3
title_en: The completed scheme, the four rate constants k1 to k4, and why experiments measure k3

points.zh: 后续研究发现，有些酶可以发生逆反应：酶与产物重新结合，生成 ES 复合物。
points.en: Later work found that for some enzymes the reverse step occurs: enzyme and product recombine to regenerate the ES complex.

points.zh: 这个逆过程速率往往比较慢，但确实存在，所以有了更完善的反应式。
points.en: That reverse process is usually slow but real, which is why a more complete scheme is used.

points.zh: 完善版相比经典版只多了一步：enzyme 与 product 反向结合成 ES。
points.en: The completed scheme adds exactly one step to the classic one: enzyme plus product going back to ES.

points.zh: 整个过程是两段式：E + S ⇌ ES，以及 ES ⇌ E + P。
points.en: The whole process is two-stage: E + S in equilibrium with ES, and ES in equilibrium with E + P.

points.zh: 每一段的正逆方向各有一个反应常数 K：E + S → ES 为 K1，ES → E + S 为 K2。
points.en: Each stage has a rate constant in each direction: E + S to ES is K1 and ES back to E + S is K2.

points.zh: 同样地，ES → E + P 为 K3，E + P → ES 为 K4，于是共有 K1、K2、K3、K4 四个常数。
points.en: Likewise ES to E + P is K3 and E + P back to ES is K4, giving the four constants K1, K2, K3 and K4.

points.zh: 实验（例如荧光法）真正测到的是 K3 那一步，因为测的是中间态生成产物的速率。
points.en: What experiments such as fluorescence assays actually capture is the K3 step, because they follow the rate at which the intermediate yields product.

points.zh: 下一步的思路：以 ES 为中心，把 K1、K2、K3、K4 联系起来，从而推出米氏方程。
points.en: The next move is to take ES as the pivot and link K1 to K4 together, which is how the Michaelis-Menten equation is derived.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 教材通用写法是 k1、k−1、k2（即 kcat）、k−2。课上的 K1、K2、K3、K4 依次对应 k1、k−1、k2、k−2；答题时按教材符号写，避免把 k2 与 k−1 弄反。
extra.en: Textbooks write k1, k minus 1, k2 (which is kcat) and k minus 2. The lecture's K1 to K4 map onto k1, k minus 1, k2 and k minus 2 in that order; use the textbook symbols in exams so k2 is not confused with k minus 1.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: ES 回到 E + S 是解离 dissociation（非共价复合物散开），不是“水解”。只有 ES → E + P 才是真正的化学转化步。
extra.en: ES returning to E + S is dissociation of a non-covalent complex, not hydrolysis. Only ES going to E + P is the genuine chemical conversion step.

extra.zh: 因为测初速度时 [P] ≈ 0，k−2（课上的 K4）项可以忽略——这正是推导米氏方程时敢于砍掉第二步逆反应的理由。
extra.en: Because product is near zero when initial velocities are measured, the k minus 2 term (the lecture's K4) can be dropped, and that is precisely why the derivation is allowed to discard the reverse of the second step.

extra.zh: 稳态动力学只能给出 Vmax 与 Km（进而 kcat），无法单独拆出 k1 和 k−1；要分别测这两个常数需要 pre-steady-state 方法，如 stopped-flow 快速混合。此外，稳态假设 d[ES]/dt = 0 属于 Briggs–Haldane 修正，比 Michaelis 原来的快速平衡假设更普适。
extra.en: Steady-state kinetics yields only Vmax and Km, and hence kcat; it cannot separate k1 from k minus 1, which requires pre-steady-state methods such as stopped-flow mixing. The steady-state assumption that d[ES]/dt is zero is the Briggs-Haldane refinement, more general than Michaelis's original rapid-equilibrium assumption.

quiz.q_zh: 课上的 K1、K2、K3、K4 依次对应教材中的哪组符号？
quiz.q_en: Which textbook symbols do the lecture's K1, K2, K3 and K4 correspond to, in order?
quiz.explain_zh: 第一段正向是 k1、逆向是 k−1；第二段正向是 k2（即 kcat）、逆向是 k−2。其余排列都把正逆方向或两段的先后顺序打乱了。
quiz.explain_en: The first stage runs forward with k1 and backward with k minus 1; the second runs forward with k2, that is kcat, and backward with k minus 2. The other orderings scramble either the directions or the sequence of the two stages.

quiz.q_zh: 完善版反应式比最早的经典版多出的是哪一步？
quiz.q_en: Which step does the completed scheme add to the earliest classic one?

options.zh: 酶与产物重新结合成 ES
options.en: enzyme and product recombining into ES

options.zh: 酶与底物结合生成 ES
options.en: enzyme and substrate combining into ES

options.zh: ES 解离回酶与底物
options.en: ES dissociating back to enzyme and substrate

options.zh: ES 分解生成酶与产物
options.en: ES breaking down into enzyme and product

quiz.explain_zh: 经典版已经包含 E + S ⇌ ES 的正逆两向以及 ES → E + P，新增的只有 E + P → ES 这一逆向步骤。其余三项在经典版里本来就有。
quiz.explain_en: The classic scheme already contains both directions of E + S to ES plus ES going to E + P; the only addition is the reverse step E + P back to ES. The other three were present all along.

quiz.q_zh: 用荧光法测初速度，直接反映的是哪一步的速率？
quiz.q_en: In a fluorescence initial-rate assay, which step's rate is measured directly?

options.zh: 酶与产物结合这一步
options.en: the step where enzyme binds product

options.zh: ES 生成产物这一步
options.en: the step where ES gives product

options.zh: 酶与底物结合这一步
options.en: the step where enzyme binds substrate

options.zh: ES 解离回底物这一步
options.en: the step where ES releases substrate

quiz.explain_zh: 测的是产物的生成速率，对应课上的 K3（教材 k2/kcat）。结合与解离这两步不直接产生可测的产物信号，需要 stopped-flow 等快速动力学方法；酶与产物结合在初速度条件下可以忽略。
quiz.explain_en: The assay follows product formation, which corresponds to the lecture's K3, the textbook k2 or kcat. Binding and dissociation generate no directly measurable product signal and need rapid-kinetics methods such as stopped-flow, while enzyme binding product is negligible under initial-rate conditions.

title_zh: 以 ES 为中心：d[ES]/dt 与四个速率常数
title_en: Centring the derivation on ES: d[ES]/dt and the four rate constants

points.zh: 推导以中间复合物 ES 为中心，目的是把 k1、k2、k3、k4 四个反应常数串到同一个式子里。
points.en: The derivation is centred on the intermediate complex ES, so that the four rate constants k1, k2, k3 and k4 can all be tied into one equation.

points.zh: d[ES]/dt 是微积分的写法（高数里学过的微分），t 就是时间。
points.en: d[ES]/dt is written in the language of calculus, with t standing for time.

points.zh: 生化里方括号 [ ] 一律代表浓度，所以 [ES] 就是中间复合物的浓度。
points.en: In biochemistry square brackets always denote concentration, so [ES] is the concentration of the intermediate complex.

points.zh: 整个问题就是：ES 这个中间物的浓度随时间如何变化，由什么决定。
points.en: The whole question is how the concentration of the ES intermediate changes with time, and what determines that change.

points.zh: 答案是由那四个反应方程式共同决定 —— 生成它的反应和消耗它的反应。
points.en: The answer is that it is set jointly by the four reaction steps: those that make ES and those that consume it.

points.zh: 生成 ES 的主要途径是 E + S 经 k1 结合，也就是图上面那一条。
points.en: The main route to ES is E + S combining via k1, the upper arm of the scheme.

points.zh: 另一条生成途径是 E + P 经 k4 逆向回到 ES，也就是图下面那一条。
points.en: The other route to ES is E + P running backwards via k4, the lower arm of the scheme.

extra.zh: 课上的编号 k1/k2/k3/k4 与多数教科书的写法对应关系要对上：k2 就是教科书的 k₋₁，k3 就是 k₂（也就是 kcat），k4 就是 k₋₂。看到不同符号不要以为是不同机制。
extra.en: Map the lecture's k1/k2/k3/k4 onto the textbook symbols: k2 here is k₋₁, k3 here is k₂ (i.e. kcat), and k4 here is k₋₂. Different symbols, same mechanism.

extra.zh: k1 是二级速率常数 (second-order, M⁻¹s⁻¹)，因为它要乘以两个浓度；k2、k3 是一级速率常数 (first-order, s⁻¹)，只乘 [ES]。这样 k1[E][S] 与 k2[ES] 的量纲才都是 M·s⁻¹，才能相加相减。
extra.en: k1 is a second-order rate constant (M⁻¹s⁻¹) because it multiplies two concentrations; k2 and k3 are first-order (s⁻¹) and multiply only [ES]. That is why k1[E][S] and k2[ES] share units of M·s⁻¹ and can be added or subtracted.

extra.zh: 这个模型默认单底物 (single-substrate)、单一 ES 中间体。真实酶常有多个中间体（如 acyl-enzyme）或多底物机制 (ordered / ping-pong)，此时米氏形式仍可能成立，但 Km、kcat 变成复合常数。
extra.en: The scheme assumes a single substrate and a single ES intermediate. Real enzymes often have several intermediates (e.g. an acyl-enzyme) or multi-substrate mechanisms (ordered, ping-pong); the Michaelis-Menten form may still hold, but Km and kcat become composite constants.

quiz.q_zh: 式子 d[ES]/dt 表示的是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does the expression d[ES]/dt represent?

options.zh: ES 复合物分解成产物的平衡常数
options.en: the equilibrium constant for ES breaking down to product

options.zh: 酶与底物结合所需要的活化能
options.en: the activation energy required for enzyme to bind substrate

options.zh: 底物浓度随酶浓度增加的变化率
options.en: the rate of change of substrate with rising enzyme level

options.zh: ES 复合物浓度随时间的变化率
options.en: the rate of change of the ES concentration with time

quiz.explain_zh: 方括号代表浓度，d…/dt 代表对时间求导，所以整体就是 [ES] 的瞬时变化速率。平衡常数是浓度之比、无时间维度；活化能是能量，都不是导数。
quiz.explain_en: Brackets mean concentration and d…/dt is a derivative with respect to time, so the whole symbol is the instantaneous rate of change of [ES]. An equilibrium constant is a ratio with no time dimension, and an activation energy is an energy; neither is a derivative.

quiz.q_zh: 按课上的编号，k4 对应的是哪一步？
quiz.q_en: In the numbering used in the lecture, which step does k4 describe?

options.zh: ES 分解为 E + P
options.en: ES going forward to E plus P

options.zh: E + P 逆向生成 ES
options.en: E plus P running back to ES

options.zh: E + S 结合生成 ES
options.en: E and S combining to give ES

options.zh: ES 分解为 E + S
options.en: ES falling apart to E plus S

quiz.explain_zh: 课上把 E+S→ES 定为 k1，ES→E+S 为 k2，ES→E+P 为 k3，剩下的 E+P→ES 就是 k4，也正是随后被假设忽略的那一步。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture assigns k1 to E+S→ES, k2 to ES→E+S and k3 to ES→E+P, which leaves E+P→ES as k4 — precisely the step that is then assumed negligible.

quiz.q_zh: 生化方程里的方括号 [ ] 代表什么？
quiz.q_en: What do square brackets [ ] denote in a biochemical equation?

options.zh: 该物种的摩尔浓度
options.en: the molar concentration of that species

options.zh: 该步骤的速率常数
options.en: the rate constant of that particular step

options.zh: 该酶的比活力
options.en: the specific activity of that enzyme

options.zh: 该物种的自由能
options.en: the free energy of that species

quiz.explain_zh: 老师特别提醒：不加方括号只是写出物种本身（species），加了方括号才涉及浓度。速率常数用 k 表示，自由能用 G 表示，都不用方括号。
quiz.explain_en: The lecturer flags this explicitly: without brackets a symbol names only the species; with brackets it means its concentration. Rate constants are written k and free energies G, never in brackets.

title_zh: 忽略 E + P → ES：米氏方程的前提假设（含课堂重述）
title_en: Neglecting E + P → ES: the assumptions behind Michaelis-Menten (with an in-class repeat)

points.zh: 下面那条 E + P 经 k4 回到 ES 的反应，一般可以直接忽略掉。
points.en: The lower arm, E + P returning to ES via k4, can generally be dropped outright.

points.zh: 第一个理由：酶再去结合产物 P 并逆行，这一步本身比较慢。
points.en: First reason: the enzyme re-binding product P and running backwards is itself a slow step.

points.zh: 第二个理由：测定酶活 (enzyme activity) 时，底物浓度远远大于酶的含量。
points.en: Second reason: when enzyme activity is measured, substrate concentration is far greater than the amount of enzyme.

points.zh: 因此在反应初期，产物 product 的积累非常非常少，逆向速率基本可以忽略。
points.en: Consequently, in the early phase of the reaction very little product has accumulated, so the reverse rate is essentially negligible.

points.zh: 老师明确指出：这就是米氏方程 (Michaelis-Menten equation) 的几个假设之一，必须记住。
points.en: The lecturer states plainly that this is one of the assumptions of the Michaelis-Menten equation and must be memorised.

points.zh: 考试情境：教授会问“米氏方程是在什么基础、什么条件下推导出来的”，要能数出几个重要假设。
