points.en: Exam framing: a professor will ask on what basis and under what conditions the Michaelis-Menten equation is derived, and you must be able to list the key assumptions.

points.zh: 学生中途打断要求重复，老师重述同样两点：这一步慢，且初期 P 的量很少。
points.en: A student interrupts and asks for the reason again; the lecturer repeats the same two points — that step is slow, and [P] is small early on.

points.zh: 忽略 k4 之后，ES 的生成就只剩 E + S 一条途径，式子才写得下去。
points.en: Once k4 is dropped, ES has only one route of formation, E + S, which is what makes the equation tractable.

extra.zh: 完整的假设清单（口试常问）：① 初速度条件，[P] ≈ 0，逆反应可忽略；② [S]₀ >> [E]t，游离底物近似等于加入的总底物；③ 只有一个 ES 中间体、单底物；④ 稳态 (steady state)，d[ES]/dt = 0（Briggs–Haldane 版本），Michaelis 原版用的是快速平衡 (rapid equilibrium)。
extra.en: The full checklist, a standard oral-exam question: (1) initial-velocity conditions, [P] ≈ 0, reverse reaction negligible; (2) [S]₀ >> [E]t, so free substrate ≈ total substrate added; (3) a single ES intermediate and a single substrate; (4) steady state, d[ES]/dt = 0 (the Briggs–Haldane form), whereas Michaelis's original version assumed rapid equilibrium.

extra.zh: 老师说“产物转过来形成这个过渡态的 ES”。ES 不是过渡态：ES 是基态的 Michaelis 复合物 (ground-state Michaelis complex)，位于能量曲线的谷底，可以积累、可以用荧光或快速动力学测到；真正的过渡态是 ES‡，位于能垒顶端，寿命约一次键振动 (~10⁻¹³ s)，浓度无法测定。酶的催化本质正是选择性地稳定 ES‡ 而不是 ES。
extra.en: The lecturer calls ES 'the transition state'. It is not: ES is the ground-state Michaelis complex, sitting in an energy well, able to accumulate and to be observed by fluorescence or rapid kinetics. The true transition state is ES‡, at the top of the barrier, lasting about one bond vibration (~10⁻¹³ s), with no measurable concentration. Catalysis works precisely by stabilising ES‡ preferentially over ES.

extra.zh: 酶不改变 ΔG，也不改变 Keq —— 它把正、逆两个方向同等加速。所以 E + P → ES 在原理上永远存在，能忽略它靠的是实验条件（初速度、产物少），不是酶只能单向工作。同理，反应可逆是热力学决定的，不是 induced fit 造成的。
extra.en: An enzyme changes neither ΔG nor Keq — it accelerates both directions equally. So E + P → ES always exists in principle; it is the experimental condition (initial rate, little product) that lets us ignore it, not any one-way property of the enzyme. By the same token, reversibility is thermodynamic, not a consequence of induced fit.

extra.zh: “初速度”在实践中的操作定义是底物消耗小于 5–10%，此时 v 对时间的曲线仍近似直线；超过这个范围，底物耗竭和产物抑制都会让测得的 v 偏低。
extra.en: In practice 'initial velocity' means less than about 5–10% of substrate consumed, where the progress curve is still linear. Beyond that, substrate depletion and product inhibition both drag the measured v downwards.

quiz.q_zh: 米氏方程推导时忽略 E + P → ES 这一步，主要依据是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why is the step E + P → ES ignored when deriving the Michaelis-Menten equation?

options.zh: 产物一旦生成就立即被彻底降解掉
options.en: product is destroyed as soon as it is formed by the enzyme

options.zh: 反应初期产物积累很少，逆反应可忽略
options.en: product is scarce early on, so the reverse step is negligible

options.zh: 酶只能催化正向反应，不能催化逆向
options.en: enzymes can catalyse only the forward direction of a reaction

options.zh: 酶对产物没有任何亲和力，无法结合
options.en: the enzyme has no affinity for product and cannot bind it

quiz.explain_zh: 理由是实验条件而非酶的本性：初速度阶段 [P] 极低，加上这一步本身较慢。说酶只能催化正向是错的 —— 酶同等加速正逆两个方向；说酶对产物毫无亲和力也不成立，产物抑制正是靠这种结合。
quiz.explain_en: The justification is experimental, not intrinsic: at initial velocity [P] is tiny, and that step is slow anyway. Claiming enzymes catalyse only the forward direction is wrong — they accelerate both equally; and claiming no affinity for product is also wrong, since product inhibition depends on exactly that binding.

quiz.q_zh: 关于 ES 复合物，下列哪种说法正确？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about the ES complex is correct?

options.zh: ES 是反应的过渡态 transition state
options.en: ES is the reaction's transition state ES‡

options.zh: ES 是酶变性后的 unfolded 中间体
options.en: ES is a partly denatured form of the enzyme

options.zh: ES 是产物释放后的 free enzyme
options.en: ES is the free enzyme left after product release

options.zh: ES 是基态的 Michaelis 复合物
options.en: ES is the ground-state Michaelis complex

quiz.explain_zh: ES 处于能量谷底，可以积累并被检测；过渡态 ES‡ 在能垒顶端，寿命约一次键振动，无法作为一个可测浓度的物种。酶催化正是通过稳定 ES‡ 来降低活化能。
quiz.explain_en: ES sits in an energy well, accumulates and can be detected; the transition state ES‡ sits at the top of the barrier and lasts about one bond vibration, so it is never a species with a measurable concentration. Catalysis lowers the barrier by stabilising ES‡.

quiz.q_zh: “底物浓度远远大于酶浓度”这个条件在推导中起什么作用？
quiz.q_en: What role does the condition [S] >> [E] play in the derivation?

options.zh: 使反应必然处于零级动力学区间
options.en: it forces the reaction into the zero-order regime

options.zh: 使 Km 直接等于解离常数 Ks
options.en: it makes Km equal to the dissociation constant Ks

options.zh: 使 kcat 随底物浓度升高而增大
options.en: it makes kcat rise as substrate concentration rises

options.zh: 使 [S] 可近似取加入的总底物浓度
options.en: it lets [S] be taken as the total substrate added

quiz.explain_zh: [S] >> [E]t 的作用是：被结合进 ES 的那点底物可以忽略，游离 [S] ≈ 总 [S]，同时保证初期产物很少。它并不决定动力学级数 —— 一级与零级的分界由 [S] 相对 Km 决定；Km = Ks 只在 k3 << k2 时成立；kcat 是常数，与 [S] 无关。
quiz.explain_en: [S] >> [E]t means the substrate tied up in ES is negligible, so free [S] ≈ total [S], and it also keeps product low early on. It does not set the reaction order — the first-order/zero-order boundary depends on [S] relative to Km; Km equals Ks only when k3 << k2; and kcat is a constant, independent of [S].

title_zh: ES 的生成速率：k1 × [游离 E] × [S]
title_en: The rate of ES formation: k1 × [free E] × [S]

points.zh: 把 S + E → ES 这一步单独拆开、详细写清楚。
points.en: The step S + E → ES is pulled out and written in full.

points.zh: ES 浓度随时间的变化（生成部分）= k1 × 游离酶浓度 × 底物浓度。
points.en: The formation part of d[ES]/dt equals k1 times the free-enzyme concentration times the substrate concentration.

points.zh: k1 是 E + S 结合这一步的反应常数，就是图上转过来生成 ES 的那一步。
points.en: k1 is the rate constant for the E + S association step, the arm that produces ES.

points.zh: 式子里的 E 必须是游离的酶：还没有结合底物、还没有生成 ES 的那部分蛋白。
points.en: The E in the expression must be free enzyme — the protein that has not yet bound substrate and has not yet formed ES.

points.zh: 底物浓度直接乘进去；这是化学反应速率的标准写法。
points.en: The substrate concentration multiplies in directly; this is the standard way a chemical rate law is written.

points.zh: 老师用“K1 = 产物 ÷ 原料”的形式说明，把式子“扯过来”得到 ES = 游离 E × S × K1。
points.en: The lecturer argues from 'K1 = product ÷ reactant', rearranging to give ES = free E × S × K1.

points.zh: 这一条在板书上用橙色标出，代表 ES 的形成速度。
points.en: This line is highlighted in orange on the board as the rate of ES formation.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 老师把 k1 当成“平衡常数 = 产物/原料”来用，写出 [ES] = k1[E][S]。严格说 k1 是速率常数 (rate constant)，正确写法是速率 v(生成) = k1[E][S]，等号左边是速率不是浓度。只有在快速平衡假设下才有浓度比值关系：Ks = k2/k1 = [E][S]/[ES]。两者结论形式相近，但一个是速率、一个是浓度，考试时不能混写。
extra.en: The lecturer treats k1 as an equilibrium constant ('product over reactant') and writes [ES] = k1[E][S]. Strictly, k1 is a rate constant and the correct statement is a rate: v(formation) = k1[E][S] — the left side is a velocity, not a concentration. A concentration ratio only appears under the rapid-equilibrium assumption, as Ks = k2/k1 = [E][S]/[ES]. The two look alike but one is a rate and the other a concentration; do not merge them in an exam.

extra.zh: 二级速率常数 k1 有物理上限：受扩散控制 (diffusion-limited)，约 10⁸–10⁹ M⁻¹s⁻¹。当酶的 kcat/Km 接近这个量级（如 carbonic anhydrase、triosephosphate isomerase）就称为“催化完美” (catalytically perfect)，每次碰撞几乎都成功。
extra.en: The second-order constant k1 has a physical ceiling set by diffusion, roughly 10⁸–10⁹ M⁻¹s⁻¹. Enzymes whose kcat/Km approaches this value (carbonic anhydrase, triosephosphate isomerase) are called catalytically perfect: nearly every encounter is productive.

extra.zh: 式中的 [S] 严格说是游离底物浓度。因为前面假设了 [S] >> [E]t，被结合进 ES 的那一小部分可以忽略，才允许用加进去的总底物浓度代替。若酶浓度与底物浓度接近（tight-binding 情形），这个近似崩溃，必须用 Morrison 方程。
extra.en: The [S] in the rate law is strictly the free substrate concentration. It is only because [S] >> [E]t was assumed that the small amount sequestered in ES can be ignored and total added substrate used instead. When enzyme and substrate concentrations are comparable (tight-binding), the approximation fails and the Morrison equation is needed.

quiz.q_zh: ES 的生成速率应写成下列哪一个？
quiz.q_en: Which expression gives the rate of ES formation?

options.zh: k1 × [总酶 E]t × [S]
options.en: k1 × [total E]t × [S]

options.zh: k3 × [游离 E] × [S]
options.en: k3 × [free E] × [S]

options.zh: k1 × [游离 E] × [S]
options.en: k1 × [free E] × [S]

quiz.explain_zh: 生成 ES 的是 E + S 结合这一步，用它自己的常数 k1，且只有游离酶能参与结合。k3 是 ES→E+P 的常数，k2[ES] 是分解项，都不描述生成。
quiz.explain_en: ES is made by the E + S association step, so it carries that step's own constant k1, and only free enzyme can take part. k3 belongs to ES→E+P and k2[ES] is a breakdown term; neither describes formation.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么速率式中必须用游离酶浓度而不是总酶浓度？
quiz.q_en: Why must the rate law use free enzyme rather than total enzyme?

options.zh: 只有游离酶能被荧光法检测到
options.en: only free enzyme can be seen by the fluorescence assay

options.zh: 总酶浓度在反应中会不断下降
options.en: total enzyme concentration falls as the reaction runs

options.zh: 已结合成 ES 的酶不能再结合底物
options.en: enzyme already tied up as ES cannot bind more substrate

options.zh: 游离酶的 kcat 高于结合态的酶
options.en: free enzyme has a higher kcat than bound enzyme does

quiz.explain_zh: 活性位点已被占据的酶无法再参与结合，所以速率只正比于尚未结合的那部分。总酶浓度 [E]t 是守恒量、并不下降；kcat 是每个酶分子的常数，与是否游离无关。
quiz.explain_en: Enzyme whose active site is already occupied cannot participate in another binding event, so the rate is proportional only to the unoccupied fraction. Total enzyme [E]t is conserved and does not fall, and kcat is a per-molecule constant unrelated to whether the enzyme is free.

quiz.q_zh: k1 属于哪一类常数？
quiz.q_en: What kind of constant is k1?

options.zh: 无量纲的化学平衡常数
options.en: a dimensionless equilibrium constant

options.zh: 零级速率常数，单位 M·s⁻¹
options.en: a zero-order rate constant, in M·s⁻¹

options.zh: 一级速率常数，单位 s⁻¹
options.en: a first-order rate constant, in s⁻¹

options.zh: 二级速率常数，单位 M⁻¹s⁻¹
options.en: a second-order rate constant, in M⁻¹s⁻¹

quiz.explain_zh: k1 要乘以 [E] 和 [S] 两个浓度才得到速率，所以是二级常数，单位 M⁻¹s⁻¹。k2、k3 只乘 [ES]，是一级常数 s⁻¹；平衡常数不带速率含义。
quiz.explain_en: k1 must multiply two concentrations, [E] and [S], to yield a rate, so it is second-order with units M⁻¹s⁻¹. k2 and k3 multiply only [ES] and are first-order (s⁻¹); an equilibrium constant carries no rate information at all.

title_zh: 把游离酶表示出来：[E]游离 = [E]总 − [ES]
title_en: Expressing free enzyme: [E]free = [E]total − [ES]

points.zh: 已经确定 d[ES]/dt 等于那一串式子，接下来的问题是：游离的酶要怎么表示出来。
points.en: With d[ES]/dt written out, the next problem is how to express the free enzyme term.

points.zh: 老师提醒：前面没加方括号，只是写出这个物种；一旦要涉及浓度就得加方括号。
points.en: The lecturer notes that up to here the symbols name only the species; once concentrations are involved, brackets must be added.

points.zh: 游离酶浓度 = 总的酶浓度 − 已经生成复合物的 [ES]。
points.en: Free enzyme concentration equals total enzyme concentration minus the [ES] already formed.

points.zh: 把这个关系代进去，实际上就是把上面那个式子展开。
points.en: Substituting that relation in is simply expanding the equation written above.

points.zh: 底物浓度则不做处理：测出来是多少就是多少，认为它不变。
points.en: Substrate concentration needs no such treatment: whatever is measured is used, and it is taken as unchanging.

points.zh: 代入后生成速率写成 k1 ([E]总 − [ES]) [S]，方程里只剩 [ES] 一个未知量。
points.en: After substitution the formation rate reads k1([E]total − [ES])[S], leaving [ES] as the only unknown in the equation.

extra.zh: [E]t = [E] + [ES] 就是酶的质量守恒式 (enzyme conservation equation)，是整个推导中唯一用到的守恒关系。最后 Vmax = k3[E]t（即 kcat[E]t）之所以成立，正是因为饱和时全部酶都以 ES 形式存在，[E] → 0。
extra.en: [E]t = [E] + [ES] is the enzyme conservation equation, the only conservation relation used in the whole derivation. Vmax = k3[E]t (that is, kcat[E]t) follows from it: at saturation all the enzyme is in the ES form and [E] → 0.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: “底物浓度测出来是多少就是多少，不会变”是近似而非恒等。只有在初速度阶段（底物消耗 <5–10%）才成立；进程曲线后段底物明显耗竭，v 会下降，这也是酶活必须取曲线起始直线段斜率的原因。
extra.en: 'Substrate is whatever you measured and does not change' is an approximation, not an identity. It holds only at initial velocity (under about 5–10% substrate consumed); later in the progress curve substrate is visibly depleted and v falls, which is exactly why activity is read off the initial linear slope.

extra.zh: [E]t 指的是活性位点的摩尔浓度，不是酶的质量浓度 mg/mL，也不一定等于蛋白摩尔浓度（寡聚酶每个亚基可能各带一个位点，部分酶分子还可能失活）。计算 kcat 必须用有功能的活性位点浓度，通常需 active-site titration 标定。
extra.en: [E]t means the molar concentration of active sites, not mg/mL of protein, and not necessarily the molar concentration of protein either (an oligomeric enzyme may carry one site per subunit, and some molecules may be inactive). Calculating kcat requires the concentration of functional sites, usually established by active-site titration.

quiz.q_zh: 游离酶浓度应该怎样表示？
quiz.q_en: How is the free enzyme concentration expressed?

options.zh: [E]总 减去 [ES]
options.en: [E]total minus [ES]

options.zh: [E]总 乘以 [ES]
options.en: [E]total times [ES]

options.zh: [ES] 减去 [E]总
options.en: [ES] minus [E]total

options.zh: [E]总 加上 [ES]
options.en: [E]total plus [ES]

quiz.explain_zh: 酶总量守恒，分成游离和已结合两部分：[E]t = [E] + [ES]，移项即得 [E] = [E]t − [ES]。相加会超出总量，相乘量纲也不对。
quiz.explain_en: Total enzyme is conserved and split into free and bound forms: [E]t = [E] + [ES], which rearranges to [E] = [E]t − [ES]. Adding would exceed the total, and multiplying gives the wrong units.

quiz.q_zh: 推导中把底物浓度视为不变，这一处理在什么条件下成立？
quiz.q_en: Under what condition may substrate concentration be treated as constant?

options.zh: 在整个反应进程中都始终严格成立
options.en: it holds strictly through the entire reaction course

options.zh: 只在底物浓度远低于 Km 时成立
options.en: it holds only while [S] remains far below Km

options.zh: 只在反应初期底物几乎未消耗时成立
options.en: it holds only early on, before much S is consumed

options.zh: 只在酶被底物完全饱和之后才成立
options.en: it holds only once the enzyme is fully saturated

quiz.explain_zh: 这是初速度 (initial velocity) 条件下的近似：底物消耗很少，[S] 才可视为常数。与 [S] 和 Km 的相对大小无关，也不需要酶饱和；反应后期底物耗竭时该近似失效。
quiz.explain_en: This is an initial-velocity approximation: only while little substrate has been consumed can [S] be held constant. It does not depend on how [S] compares with Km, nor does it require saturation, and it breaks down once substrate is depleted.

quiz.q_zh: 关系式 [E]t = [E] + [ES] 在推导中扮演什么角色？
quiz.q_en: What role does [E]t = [E] + [ES] play in the derivation?

options.zh: 酶的质量守恒关系
options.en: the enzyme conservation relation

options.zh: 稳态假设的数学形式
options.en: the mathematical steady-state condition

options.zh: 快速平衡假设的表达
options.en: a statement of rapid equilibrium

options.zh: 初速度条件的表达
options.en: a statement of initial-rate conditions

quiz.explain_zh: 它说明酶只以游离和结合两种形式存在、总量不变，属于守恒方程。稳态假设是 d[ES]/dt = 0，快速平衡是 k1[E][S] = k2[ES]，初速度条件是 [P] ≈ 0，三者都是另外的式子。
quiz.explain_en: It states that enzyme exists only as free or bound forms and that the total is fixed — a conservation equation. The steady-state assumption is d[ES]/dt = 0, rapid equilibrium is k1[E][S] = k2[ES], and the initial-rate condition is [P] ≈ 0; all three are separate statements.

title_zh: ES 的分解速率：k2[ES] + k3[ES]，负号与稳态的引入
title_en: The rate of ES breakdown: k2[ES] + k3[ES], the minus sign, and the run-up to steady state

points.zh: 橙色标出的那一条是 ES 的形成速度；与之相对的是 ES 的分解速度。
points.en: The line marked in orange is the rate of ES formation; set against it is the rate of ES breakdown.

points.zh: ES 的分解有两条路：一条经 k2 分解回原料 E + S。
points.en: ES breaks down by two routes: one is via k2, back to the reactants E + S.

points.zh: 另一条经 k3 分解成产物 E + P，也就是真正生成产物的那一步。
points.en: The other is via k3 to E + P, the step that actually generates product.

points.zh: 分解回原料的速率是 k2 × [ES]，因为这是“倒过来”的那一步。
points.en: Breakdown back to reactants runs at k2 × [ES], since that is the reverse arm.

points.zh: 分解成产物的速率是 k3 × [ES]，即向右的那一步。
points.en: Breakdown to product runs at k3 × [ES], the forward arm.

points.zh: 把这两段加起来就是总的分解速度：k2[ES] + k3[ES]。
points.en: Adding the two gives the total breakdown rate: k2[ES] + k3[ES].

points.zh: 形成速度里没有两项相加，是因为最前面已经把 E + P → ES 那一条忽略掉了。
points.en: There is no second additive term in the formation rate because the E + P → ES route was dropped at the very start.

points.zh: 分解速度前面要带负号，写成 −d[ES]/dt，因为它消耗 ES。
points.en: The breakdown term carries a minus sign, written −d[ES]/dt, because it consumes ES.

points.zh: 之所以要分别写形成和分解，是为了接下来的假设：酶促反应达到稳态时，ES 中间体的形成与分解相等。
points.en: Formation and breakdown are written separately in order to set up the next assumption: at steady state the ES intermediate is formed and consumed at equal rates.

extra.zh: 把稳态条件写出来即可完成推导：k1([E]t − [ES])[S] = (k2 + k3)[ES]。整理得 [ES] = [E]t[S] / (Km + [S])，其中 Km = (k2 + k3)/k1；再乘 k3 得 v = k3[ES]，即 v = Vmax[S]/(Km + [S])，Vmax = k3[E]t = kcat[E]t。
extra.en: Writing the steady-state condition finishes the derivation: k1([E]t − [ES])[S] = (k2 + k3)[ES]. Rearranging gives [ES] = [E]t[S]/(Km + [S]) with Km = (k2 + k3)/k1; multiplying by k3 gives v = k3[ES] = Vmax[S]/(Km + [S]), where Vmax = k3[E]t = kcat[E]t.

extra.zh: 一级动力学与零级动力学的分界由 [S] 相对 Km 决定，不是由“底物分子数多于酶分子数”决定。[S] << Km 时 v ≈ (Vmax/Km)[S]，近似一级；[S] >> Km 时酶被饱和，v ≈ Vmax，为零级。注意 [S] >> [E]t 在整条曲线上都成立，却完全不能保证反应是零级 —— 两个不等式比较的是完全不同的量。
extra.en: The boundary between first-order and zero-order kinetics is set by [S] relative to Km, not by substrate molecules outnumbering enzyme molecules. When [S] << Km, v ≈ (Vmax/Km)[S] and the reaction is pseudo-first-order; when [S] >> Km the enzyme is saturated and v ≈ Vmax, which is zero-order. Note that [S] >> [E]t holds along the whole curve yet guarantees nothing about the order — the two inequalities compare entirely different quantities.

extra.zh: 稳态假设 (steady state, Briggs–Haldane 1925) 与快速平衡假设 (rapid equilibrium, Michaelis–Menten 1913 原版) 是两套不同前提：前者只要求 d[ES]/dt ≈ 0，得到 Km = (k2 + k3)/k1；后者额外要求 k3 << k2，此时 Km ≈ Ks = k2/k1，才可解释为解离常数、才等同于亲和力的倒数。因此“Km 越小亲和力越强”只在 k3 << k2 时严格成立。
extra.en: The steady-state assumption (Briggs–Haldane, 1925) and the rapid-equilibrium assumption (Michaelis and Menten's original 1913 treatment) are different premises. The first requires only d[ES]/dt ≈ 0 and yields Km = (k2 + k3)/k1; the second additionally requires k3 << k2, in which case Km ≈ Ks = k2/k1 and can be read as a dissociation constant, hence as an inverse affinity. So 'smaller Km means tighter binding' is strictly true only when k3 << k2.

quiz.q_zh: ES 的总分解速率等于下列哪一个？
quiz.q_en: Which expression gives the total rate of ES breakdown?

options.zh: k1[E][S] + k3[ES]
options.en: k1[E][S] + k3[ES]

options.zh: k2[ES] + k3[ES]
options.en: k2[ES] + k3[ES]

options.zh: k2[ES] − k3[ES]
options.en: k2[ES] − k3[ES]

options.zh: k1[E][S] − k2[ES]
options.en: k1[E][S] − k2[ES]

quiz.explain_zh: ES 有两条消耗途径：回到 E + S（k2）和前进到 E + P（k3），两者都消耗 ES，所以相加。含 k1[E][S] 的式子描述的是生成，不属于分解项。
quiz.explain_en: ES is consumed by two routes — back to E + S via k2 and forward to E + P via k3 — and both drain ES, so they add. Any expression containing k1[E][S] describes formation, not breakdown.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么 ES 的生成速率只有一项，而分解速率是两项相加？
quiz.q_en: Why does ES formation have one term while breakdown has two added together?

options.zh: 生成速率远小于分解速率可略
options.en: formation is far slower than breakdown, so it drops

options.zh: E+P→ES 一路已被假设忽略
options.en: the E + P → ES route was assumed negligible

options.zh: ES 的生成只能是单分子反应
options.en: formation can only ever be a unimolecular step

options.zh: 分解两条路的速率常数相等
options.en: the two breakdown constants happen to be equal

quiz.explain_zh: 原本生成 ES 也有两条路（E+S 经 k1、E+P 经 k4），但 k4 那条在假设中被删掉，只剩一项；分解的 k2 和 k3 两条都保留，所以要相加。生成是双分子反应，两条分解路的常数一般也不相等。
quiz.explain_en: ES formation also had two routes originally — E+S via k1 and E+P via k4 — but the k4 arm was assumed away, leaving one term, while both breakdown arms k2 and k3 are kept and must be summed. Formation is bimolecular, and the two breakdown constants are generally not equal.

quiz.q_zh: 酶促反应从一级动力学转为零级动力学，取决于什么？
quiz.q_en: What determines the switch from first-order to zero-order kinetics?

options.zh: k2 相对 k3 的大小
options.en: k2 relative to k3

options.zh: [P] 相对 [S] 的大小
options.en: [P] relative to [S]

options.zh: [S] 相对 Km 的大小
options.en: [S] relative to Km

options.zh: [S] 相对 [E]t 的大小
options.en: [S] relative to [E]t

quiz.explain_zh: [S] << Km 时 v 随 [S] 线性上升，近似一级；[S] >> Km 时酶饱和，v ≈ Vmax，与 [S] 无关，为零级。[S] >> [E]t 在整条曲线上都成立却不改变级数；k2/k3 之比只影响 Km 能否解释为 Ks。
quiz.explain_en: When [S] << Km, v rises linearly with [S] and the reaction is pseudo-first-order; when [S] >> Km the enzyme is saturated and v ≈ Vmax, independent of [S], i.e. zero-order. [S] >> [E]t holds along the entire curve without changing the order, and the ratio of k2 to k3 only decides whether Km can be read as Ks.

title_zh: 稳态假设：ES 的生成速率等于分解速率
title_en: The steady-state assumption: ES forms as fast as it breaks down

points.zh: 推导的第二个假设：酶反应达到稳态 steady state 时，中间复合物 ES 的生成速率与分解速率相等。
points.en: The second assumption of the derivation: at steady state, the intermediate complex ES is formed exactly as fast as it is consumed.

points.zh: 生成速率只有一项 k1[E][S]，因为最前面的第一个假设已经把 k4（product 回头变成 ES）那一步忽略掉了。
points.en: The formation rate has only one term, k1[E][S], because the first assumption already discarded k4, the step in which product runs back to ES.

points.zh: 分解速率是两项相加：k2[ES]（散回 E + S）加上 k3[ES]（继续生成 product），所以式子中间有一个加号。
points.en: The breakdown rate is a sum of two terms, k2[ES] (back to E + S) plus k3[ES] (on to product) — hence the plus sign in that expression.

points.zh: 分解速率写作 -d[ES]/dt，前面带负号，表示这条路径是在消耗 ES。
points.en: The breakdown rate is written -d[ES]/dt, with the minus sign marking that these routes consume ES.

points.zh: 稳态的生物学含义：[ES] 的浓度在这段时间里保持相对稳定，不随时间明显上下变化。
points.en: What steady state means biologically: the concentration of ES stays essentially constant over the observation window, not rising or falling appreciably.

points.zh: 把式①（生成速率）和式②（分解速率）令相等，就是整个米氏方程推导的出发点。
points.en: Setting equation 1 (formation) equal to equation 2 (breakdown) is the starting point of the whole Michaelis-Menten derivation.

points.zh: 老师强调：推导中间的代数式一个都不用背，只要能用嘴把这条逻辑链讲出来就算掌握。
points.en: The lecturer stresses that none of the intermediate algebra needs to be memorised — being able to say the logic out loud is what counts.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 课上说"只有酶处在 Vmax 状态时才达到稳态"。实际上 steady state 在初速度阶段的任意 [S] 下都成立，与是否达到 Vmax 无关。正因为稳态不限于饱和条件，米氏方程才能描述整条 v–[S] 曲线，而不只是曲线的平台段。
extra.en: The lecture says steady state is reached only when the enzyme is running at Vmax. In fact the steady state holds at any [S] during the initial-rate phase, saturated or not. That is precisely why the Michaelis-Menten equation describes the whole v–[S] curve rather than only its plateau.

extra.zh: ES 是基态的 Michaelis complex（ground-state complex），不是 transition state 过渡态，课上多次把它叫作"中间过渡态"。transition state 是能垒顶端的瞬时构型，寿命约 10⁻¹³ s；酶的催化本质是选择性稳定 transition state，而不是把 ES 结合得越紧越好——ES 结合过强反而形成热力学陷阱，降低催化效率。
extra.en: ES is the ground-state Michaelis complex, not the transition state, although the lecture repeatedly calls it one. The transition state is the fleeting configuration at the top of the barrier, lifetime around 10⁻¹³ s. Catalysis works by selectively stabilising the transition state, not by binding ES ever more tightly — over-tight ES binding creates a thermodynamic pit and lowers turnover.

extra.zh: "令生成速率 = 分解速率"的 steady-state 处理是 Briggs 与 Haldane 在 1925 年引入的；Michaelis 与 Menten 1913 年的原始推导用的是 rapid equilibrium 快速平衡假设（k3 远小于 k2，ES 与 E+S 之间维持结合平衡）。两者得到的方程形式相同，但常数含义不同：rapid equilibrium 下 Km = k2/k1 = Kd，steady state 下 Km = (k2+k3)/k1，因此 Km ≥ Kd。
extra.en: Equating formation and breakdown is the steady-state treatment introduced by Briggs and Haldane in 1925; the original 1913 Michaelis-Menten derivation used the rapid-equilibrium assumption (k3 much smaller than k2, so ES stays in binding equilibrium with E + S). Both give the same algebraic form but different constants: under rapid equilibrium Km = k2/k1 = Kd, under steady state Km = (k2+k3)/k1, so Km is always greater than or equal to Kd.

quiz.q_zh: 稳态假设中，ES 的分解速率由哪些项组成？
quiz.q_en: Under the steady-state assumption, which terms make up the rate of ES breakdown?

options.zh: k3[ES] 单独一项
options.en: k3[ES] on its own

options.zh: k1[E][S] 加 k2[ES]
options.en: k1[E][S] plus k2[ES]

options.zh: k2[ES] 加 k3[ES]
options.en: k2[ES] plus k3[ES]

options.zh: k1[E][S] 单独一项
options.en: k1[E][S] on its own

quiz.explain_zh: ES 有两条去路，散回 E + S（k2）和向前生成 product（k3），两条都消耗 ES，所以分解速率是两项之和。凡是出现 k1[E][S] 的写法都属于 ES 的生成项，方向相反；只写 k3[ES] 则漏掉了逆向解离这条路。
quiz.explain_en: ES has two exits — back to E + S via k2 and forward to product via k3 — and both consume it, so the breakdown rate is their sum. The choices containing k1[E][S] describe formation, which runs the other way, and k3[ES] alone omits the dissociation route.

quiz.q_zh: 酶促反应的 steady state 稳态指的是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does the steady state of an enzyme reaction actually mean?

options.zh: 正反应与逆反应速率相等，体系达到化学平衡
options.en: Forward and reverse rates are equal, so the system is at equilibrium

options.zh: 底物与产物的浓度相等，反应不再向前推进
options.en: Substrate and product concentrations are equal, so net turnover stops

options.zh: 酶全部以游离形式 E 存在，[ES] 降为零
options.en: All enzyme sits in the free form E, so [ES] has fallen to zero

options.zh: [ES] 的生成与分解速率相等，浓度恒定
options.en: ES is made and consumed at equal rates, so [ES] stays constant

quiz.explain_zh: 稳态只要求中间体的浓度不变，整体反应仍在净向前进行、底物在不断被消耗；把它说成化学平衡是最常见的混淆，平衡态下净反应速率为零，那就测不到任何 v 了。说酶全部游离或底物产物浓度相等都与稳态无关。
quiz.explain_en: Steady state only requires the intermediate to hold constant while the overall reaction still runs forward and consumes substrate. Calling it chemical equilibrium is the classic error — at equilibrium the net rate is zero and no v could be measured. Neither all-free enzyme nor equal substrate and product concentrations is part of the definition.

title_zh: 整理式子并定义 Km =（k2 + k3）/ k1
title_en: Rearranging the balance and defining Km = (k2 + k3)/k1

points.zh: 两个速率式令相等后，同时消去公共项，做的是纯数学手段：把所有速率常数挪到一边，把所有酶的浓度项挪到另一边。
points.en: After the two rate expressions are set equal, the common factor is cancelled and the rest is pure algebra: all the rate constants to one side, all the enzyme concentration terms to the other.

points.zh: 米氏（Michaelis）在这里引入了一个属于他自己的反应常数 Km，令右边那一坨等于 Km。
points.en: At this point Michaelis introduced a constant of his own, Km, defined as the whole cluster of rate constants on the right-hand side.

points.zh: Km 的定义式是 Km =（k2 + k3）/ k1。
points.en: The defining expression is Km = (k2 + k3)/k1.

points.zh: 分子上的 k2 与 k3 都是 ES 分解方向的常数：k2 是散回 E + S，k3 是向前生成 product。
points.en: The two constants on top, k2 and k3, both describe ES breaking down: k2 back to E + S, k3 forward to product.

points.zh: 分母上的 k1 是 ES 生成方向的常数。
points.en: The constant underneath, k1, describes ES being formed.

points.zh: 所以 Km 在形式上是"分解常数之和 比上 生成常数"，反映 ES 这个复合物散掉与形成的相对倾向，是有物理含义的，不是随手凑出来的符号。
points.en: So Km is structurally the sum of the breakdown constants over the formation constant, expressing how readily the ES complex falls apart versus how readily it forms — it carries real meaning rather than being an arbitrary abbreviation.

points.zh: Km 越大，说明 ES 越倾向于散掉、越不容易维持。
points.en: The larger Km is, the more ES tends to fall apart and the harder it is to maintain.

points.zh: 老师再次强调：中间那一长串式子不用记，需要记住的是 Km 的定义和它是怎么来的。
points.en: The lecturer repeats that the long intermediate expression need not be memorised — what must be retained is the definition of Km and where it comes from.

extra.zh: 课上把 k1、k2、k3 都称为"平衡常数"。它们是 rate constant 速率常数，不是 equilibrium constant 平衡常数。k1 是二级速率常数，单位 M⁻¹·s⁻¹；k2、k3 是一级速率常数，单位 s⁻¹。正因为量纲这样搭配，（k2 + k3）/ k1 的单位才是浓度 M——这也是 Km 能与 [S] 相加的前提。
extra.en: The lecture calls k1, k2 and k3 equilibrium constants. They are rate constants. k1 is second order with units M⁻¹·s⁻¹, while k2 and k3 are first order with units s⁻¹, which is exactly why (k2 + k3)/k1 comes out in units of concentration — the reason Km can legitimately be added to [S].

extra.zh: Km 还有一个不依赖任何单个 k 的操作定义：使 v = Vmax/2 的底物浓度，单位 mol/L，可以直接从 v–[S] 曲线上读出来。由此得到的记法是——Km 大表示需要更高的 [S] 才达到半饱和，即表观亲和力弱。Km 与亲和力是反比关系，考试里极易记反。
extra.en: Km also has an operational definition that needs no individual rate constant: it is the substrate concentration giving v = Vmax/2, in mol/L, readable straight off the v–[S] curve. Hence the rule to remember — a large Km means a higher [S] is needed for half-saturation, i.e. weaker apparent affinity. Km runs inversely to affinity, and it is very easy to invert this in an exam.

extra.zh: Km 只有在 k3 远小于 k2 时才近似等于解离常数 Kd = k2/k1。当催化步 k3 与 k2 相当甚至更大时（例如接近扩散极限的高效酶），Km 明显大于 Kd，此时直接把 Km 当作结合亲和力常数会低估酶对底物的真实结合强度。
extra.en: Km approximates the dissociation constant Kd = k2/k1 only when k3 is much smaller than k2. When the catalytic step is comparable to or faster than dissociation, as in near-diffusion-limited enzymes, Km is clearly larger than Kd, and reading Km straight off as a binding constant understates how tightly the enzyme actually binds its substrate.

quiz.q_zh: Km 的定义式是下面哪一个？
quiz.q_en: Which expression is the definition of Km?
quiz.explain_zh: Km 是 ES 两条分解途径的速率常数之和，比上 ES 的生成速率常数，所以 k2 与 k3 在分子、k1 在分母。把 k1 放在分子上的写法是把它整个倒过来了；把 k1 与 k2 相加的写法则把生成项和分解项混在了一起，量纲也不成立。
quiz.explain_en: Km is the sum of the rate constants for the two routes by which ES breaks down, divided by the constant for its formation, so k2 and k3 belong on top and k1 underneath. Putting k1 on top simply inverts the whole thing, and summing k1 with k2 mixes a formation term with a breakdown term, which does not even work dimensionally.

quiz.q_zh: Km 与酶对底物的表观亲和力之间是什么关系？
quiz.q_en: How does Km relate to an enzyme's apparent affinity for its substrate?

options.zh: Km 与表观亲和力彼此无关
options.en: The value of Km is unrelated to the apparent affinity

options.zh: Km 越大，表观亲和力越弱
options.en: The larger Km is, the weaker the apparent affinity

options.zh: Km 越大，表观亲和力越强
options.en: The larger Km is, the stronger the apparent affinity

options.zh: Km 越小，表观亲和力越弱
options.en: The smaller Km is, the weaker the apparent affinity

quiz.explain_zh: Km 是半饱和所需的底物浓度，需要的底物越多说明结合越松，所以是反比关系。认为 Km 越大亲和力越强，或者认为 Km 越小亲和力越弱，都是把这个反比关系记反了；说两者无关则忽略了 Km 定义中 k1 在分母上的位置。
quiz.explain_en: Km is the substrate concentration required for half-saturation, so needing more substrate means looser binding — an inverse relationship. Saying a large Km means stronger binding, or that a small Km means weaker binding, inverts it, and calling them unrelated ignores that k1 sits in the denominator of the definition.

quiz.q_zh: Km 的量纲是什么？
quiz.q_en: What are the units of Km?

options.zh: 一级速率，s⁻¹
options.en: first-order rate, s⁻¹

options.zh: 二级速率，M⁻¹·s⁻¹
options.en: second-order rate, M⁻¹·s⁻¹

options.zh: 无量纲的纯比值
options.en: a pure dimensionless ratio

options.zh: 浓度，mol/L
options.en: concentration, mol/L

quiz.explain_zh: k2、k3 的单位是 s⁻¹，k1 的单位是 M⁻¹·s⁻¹，相除后剩下 M，所以 Km 是一个浓度。s⁻¹ 是 kcat 的单位，M⁻¹·s⁻¹ 是 kcat/Km 的单位；如果 Km 无量纲，它就不能与 [S] 相加，米氏方程的分母也就写不出来。
quiz.explain_en: k2 and k3 carry s⁻¹ and k1 carries M⁻¹·s⁻¹, so the quotient leaves M — Km is a concentration. s⁻¹ belongs to kcat and M⁻¹·s⁻¹ to kcat/Km, and a dimensionless Km could not be added to [S], which would make the denominator of the Michaelis-Menten equation meaningless.

title_zh: 用可测的 v = k3[ES] 替换测不到的 [ES]
title_en: Replacing the unmeasurable [ES] with the measurable rate v = k3[ES]

points.zh: 下一步是把 k3 想办法带进含 Km 的式子里，因为实验上真正能测到的就是 k3 所对应的这一步。
points.en: The next move is to work k3 into the expression containing Km, because k3 corresponds to the only step the experiment can actually see.

points.zh: 实验测的从来不是某一个单独的速率常数，而是产物 product 生成所给出的信号或量。
points.en: What an assay measures is never an individual rate constant but the amount or signal from the product being formed.

points.zh: 反应速率的表达式是 v = k3 × [ES]：产物生成速率等于中间复合物的量乘以催化步的速率常数。
points.en: The rate expression is v = k3 × [ES]: product appears at a rate set by how much intermediate complex there is, times the catalytic rate constant.

points.zh: 体系里 [ES] 的浓度基本上无法直接测定，直接去测中间复合物这个蛋白种类的浓度是做不到的。
points.en: The concentration of ES in the mixture essentially cannot be measured directly; there is no way to read off the amount of that intermediate protein species.

points.zh: 所以反过来用可测的 v 表示 [ES]，即 [ES] = v / k3，把式中出现的 [ES] 全部替换掉。
points.en: So the measurable v is turned round to express [ES] as v/k3, and every occurrence of [ES] in the equation is substituted out.

points.zh: 替换后与前面的式子整合，就得到 v = k3 乘以一串只含 [E]、[S] 和 Km 的表达式。
points.en: Merging that substitution back into the earlier expression yields v equal to k3 times a cluster containing only [E], [S] and Km.

points.zh: 这一步的科学意义：把方程里所有不可观测的量都换成可观测的量，方程才具有实验价值。
points.en: The point of this step is that every unobservable quantity is traded for an observable one, which is what makes the equation experimentally useful.

extra.zh: 课上说"测不到过渡态的浓度"。这里测不到的是 ES 这个 Michaelis complex 的浓度，它是基态复合物，原则上可以通过快速动力学（stopped-flow）间接追踪；真正的 transition state 则连原则上都无法直接测浓度，寿命只有一次键振动的量级。两者不能混为一谈。
extra.en: The lecture says the transition state's concentration cannot be measured. What is unmeasurable here is [ES], the ground-state Michaelis complex, which can in fact be followed indirectly by rapid kinetics such as stopped-flow. The true transition state is unmeasurable even in principle, existing for about the time of a single bond vibration. The two must not be conflated.

extra.zh: 式中的 k3 就是 kcat，即 turnover number 转换数，单位 s⁻¹，含义是每个酶活性位点每秒能转化多少个底物分子。当催化机制不止一个化学步时，kcat 是若干速率常数的复合量，不再等于任何单一的 k3。
extra.en: The k3 in this scheme is kcat, the turnover number, in s⁻¹ — how many substrate molecules one active site converts per second. When the mechanism has more than one chemical step, kcat becomes a composite of several rate constants rather than any single k3.

extra.zh: 由 Vmax = kcat × [E]总 可知，Vmax 随加入的酶量线性变化，因此它不是酶的固有常数；kcat 和 kcat/Km 才是与酶量无关的固有参数。kcat/Km 称为特异性常数 specificity constant，其上限受底物扩散速度限制，约为 10⁸–10⁹ M⁻¹·s⁻¹，达到这个区间的酶称为催化完美酶。
extra.en: Since Vmax = kcat × [E]total, Vmax scales linearly with how much enzyme was added and is therefore not an intrinsic constant; kcat and kcat/Km are the enzyme-intrinsic parameters. kcat/Km, the specificity constant, is capped by how fast substrate can diffuse in, around 10⁸–10⁹ M⁻¹·s⁻¹, and enzymes reaching that range are called catalytically perfect.

quiz.q_zh: 推导中为什么要用 v = k3[ES] 把 [ES] 替换掉？
quiz.q_en: Why is [ES] substituted out using v = k3[ES] during the derivation?

options.zh: [ES] 随时间线性增加，数值并不固定
options.en: [ES] climbs linearly with time and so is never a fixed value

options.zh: [ES] 测不到，而 v 可以直接测得
options.en: [ES] cannot be measured, while v follows from product formed

options.zh: [ES] 在稳态下恒等于零，必须换掉
options.en: [ES] is identically zero at steady state and must be removed

options.zh: k3 是三个速率常数中数值最大的一个
options.en: k3 is the largest of the three rate constants in the scheme

quiz.explain_zh: 整个替换的动机是把不可观测量换成可观测量：中间复合物的浓度测不到，而产物生成速率可以直接测。说 [ES] 在稳态下为零恰恰说反了，稳态的定义是 [ES] 恒定于某个非零值；说 [ES] 线性增加同样与稳态矛盾；k3 的数值大小与要不要替换无关。
quiz.explain_en: The whole point is to trade an unobservable for an observable: the intermediate's concentration cannot be read out, whereas the rate of product formation can. Claiming [ES] is zero at steady state inverts the definition, which fixes [ES] at a constant non-zero value; claiming it climbs linearly contradicts the steady state just as badly; and how large k3 happens to be has no bearing on the substitution.

quiz.q_zh: Vmax 与 kcat 之中，哪个才是酶本身的固有常数？
quiz.q_en: Between Vmax and kcat, which is a constant intrinsic to the enzyme itself?

options.zh: 两者都与加入的酶量成正比
options.en: Both of them scale with the amount of enzyme added

options.zh: 两者都与加入的酶量无关
options.en: Neither of them depends on the amount of enzyme added

options.zh: kcat，Vmax 与加入的酶量成正比
options.en: kcat, since Vmax scales with the amount of enzyme added

options.zh: Vmax，kcat 与加入的酶量成正比
options.en: Vmax, since kcat scales with the amount of enzyme added

quiz.explain_zh: Vmax = kcat × [E]总，多加一倍酶 Vmax 就翻一倍，所以 Vmax 是随实验条件走的量；kcat 是每个活性位点每秒的转换数，与加了多少酶无关。认为 kcat 随酶量变化是把两者的角色对调了。
quiz.explain_en: Vmax = kcat × [E]total, so doubling the enzyme doubles Vmax — it is a property of the assay, not the protein. kcat is turnover per active site per second and does not care how much enzyme was pipetted in. Saying kcat scales with enzyme amount swaps the roles of the two.

title_zh: 第三个假设 [S] 远大于 [E]，代入后得到米氏方程
title_en: The third assumption, [S] far above [E], and arriving at the Michaelis-Menten equation

points.zh: 第三个假设：测 Vmax 的条件是底物浓度远远大于酶的浓度，即 [S] >> [E]。
points.en: The third assumption: Vmax is measured under conditions where substrate concentration greatly exceeds enzyme concentration, [S] >> [E].

points.zh: 课上给出的推论：此时理论上所有的酶都被底物饱和了。
points.en: The inference drawn in the lecture: under those conditions every enzyme molecule is, in principle, saturated with substrate.

points.zh: 于是认为总的酶浓度与结合态的 [ES] 基本相等，把式中的游离酶 [E] 换成 [ES]。
points.en: Total enzyme concentration is then taken as essentially equal to [ES], and the free enzyme term [E] in the expression is replaced by [ES].

points.zh: 再把前面得到的 v = k3[ES] 代进去，经过这一连串替换，最终整理出米氏方程。
points.en: Feeding in the earlier relation v = k3[ES] and working through this chain of substitutions finally produces the Michaelis-Menten equation.

points.zh: 米氏方程的形式：v = Vmax × [S] /（Km + [S]）。
points.en: The Michaelis-Menten equation reads v = Vmax × [S]/(Km + [S]).

points.zh: 三个假设是环环相扣的：忽略 k4 → ES 处于稳态 → 高底物浓度下酶被饱和。
points.en: The three assumptions interlock: neglect k4, put ES at steady state, then saturate the enzyme at high substrate.

points.zh: 老师形容这个推导"特别特别肉"，但考的是这条逻辑链，不是代数细节。
points.en: The lecturer calls the derivation extremely laborious, but insists that what gets examined is the logical chain, not the algebraic detail.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: [S] >> [E] 本身并不等于酶被饱和。饱和与否由 [S] 相对于 Km 决定：[S] >> Km 时 [ES] ≈ [E]总、v ≈ Vmax，反应对底物呈零级；[S] << Km 时 v ≈ (Vmax/Km)[S]，呈一级——此时即使底物分子数远多于酶分子数，酶也远未饱和。[S] >> [E] 在标准推导中的真正作用是保证游离底物浓度约等于加入的总底物浓度，与饱和是两回事。
extra.en: [S] >> [E] does not by itself mean the enzyme is saturated. Saturation is decided by [S] relative to Km: when [S] >> Km, [ES] approaches [E]total and v approaches Vmax, giving zero-order behaviour; when [S] << Km, v is approximately (Vmax/Km)[S], first order — and there the enzyme is far from saturated even though substrate molecules vastly outnumber enzyme molecules. The real job of [S] >> [E] in the standard derivation is to let free substrate be equated with total added substrate.

extra.zh: 由 v = Vmax[S]/(Km + [S]) 可以直接算出：[S] = Km 时 v = 0.5 Vmax；[S] = 10 Km 时 v ≈ 0.91 Vmax；要达到 0.99 Vmax 需要 [S] = 99 Km。所以"饱和"只是渐近逼近，v–[S] 曲线是一条直角双曲线 rectangular hyperbola，实验上永远达不到真正的 Vmax，这也是为什么要用双倒数作图或非线性拟合来外推。
extra.en: Straight from v = Vmax[S]/(Km + [S]): at [S] = Km, v = 0.5 Vmax; at [S] = 10 Km, v is about 0.91 Vmax; reaching 0.99 Vmax needs [S] = 99 Km. Saturation is therefore only asymptotic — the v–[S] curve is a rectangular hyperbola and true Vmax is never attained experimentally, which is why it is extrapolated by double-reciprocal plots or non-linear fitting.

extra.zh: 推导中真正用到的守恒关系是 [E]总 = [E]游离 + [ES]。保留它而不做 [E]总 ≈ [ES] 的近似，可以得到普遍成立的 v = kcat[E]总[S] /（Km + [S]），其中 Vmax = kcat[E]总。课上那个"酶全部饱和"的近似只是这个通式在 [S] >> Km 时的极限情形。
extra.en: The conservation relation actually used is [E]total = [E]free + [ES]. Keeping it instead of approximating [E]total by [ES] gives the generally valid form v = kcat[E]total[S]/(Km + [S]), with Vmax = kcat[E]total. The lecture's fully-saturated approximation is just the limiting case of this general form when [S] >> Km.

quiz.q_zh: 米氏方程的正确形式是哪一个？
quiz.q_en: Which is the correct form of the Michaelis-Menten equation?

options.zh: v = Vmax[S] /（Km + [S]）
options.en: v = Vmax[S]/(Km + [S])

options.zh: v = Vmax[S] /（Km × [S]）
options.en: v = Vmax[S]/(Km × [S])

options.zh: v = Vmax·Km /（Km + [S]）
options.en: v = Vmax·Km/(Km + [S])

options.zh: v = Vmax（Km + [S]）/ [S]
options.en: v = Vmax(Km + [S])/[S]

quiz.explain_zh: 只有 Vmax[S]/(Km + [S]) 满足两端行为：[S] 很小时 v 与 [S] 成正比，[S] 很大时 v 趋近 Vmax，且 [S] = Km 时正好是 Vmax 的一半。分母写成 Km 与 [S] 相乘的式子在 [S] 增大时反而让 v 下降；分子换成 Km 的式子与 [S] 无关地随 [S] 增大而变小；把分式整个倒过来的式子在高底物下发散。
quiz.explain_en: Only Vmax[S]/(Km + [S]) behaves correctly at both ends: v is proportional to [S] when substrate is scarce, approaches Vmax when substrate is abundant, and equals half of Vmax exactly at [S] = Km. Multiplying Km by [S] in the denominator makes v fall as substrate rises; putting Km in the numerator does the same; and inverting the whole fraction diverges at high substrate.

quiz.q_zh: 酶促反应由一级过渡到零级，这个分界主要由什么决定？
quiz.q_en: What sets the crossover from first-order to zero-order behaviour in an enzyme reaction?

options.zh: [S] 相对于 [E] 的大小
options.en: the size of [S] relative to [E]

options.zh: [E] 相对于 Km 的大小
options.en: the size of [E] relative to Km

options.zh: Vmax 相对于 kcat 的大小
options.en: the size of Vmax relative to kcat

options.zh: [S] 相对于 Km 的大小
options.en: the size of [S] relative to Km

quiz.explain_zh: 反应级数由酶被占据的程度决定，而占据程度只取决于 [S] 与 Km 的比值：[S] << Km 为一级，[S] >> Km 为零级。用 [S] 与 [E] 相比是最常见的陷阱——底物分子数远多于酶分子数在任何酶反应里几乎都成立，却完全不能说明酶是否饱和。[E] 与 Km 或 Vmax 与 kcat 的比较只反映加了多少酶。
quiz.explain_en: Reaction order is fixed by how occupied the enzyme is, and occupancy depends only on the ratio of [S] to Km: first order when [S] << Km, zero order when [S] >> Km. Comparing [S] with [E] is the standard trap — substrate outnumbers enzyme in virtually every assay, which says nothing about saturation. Comparing [E] with Km, or Vmax with kcat, only reports how much enzyme was added.

quiz.q_zh: 当底物浓度恰好等于 Km 时，反应速率 v 等于多少？
quiz.q_en: When the substrate concentration equals Km exactly, what is the rate v?

options.zh: 与 Vmax 完全相等
options.en: exactly equal to Vmax

options.zh: Vmax 的二分之一
options.en: one half of Vmax

options.zh: Vmax 的四分之一
options.en: one quarter of Vmax

options.zh: Vmax 的两倍
options.en: twice the value of Vmax

quiz.explain_zh: 把 [S] = Km 代入 v = Vmax[S]/(Km + [S])，分母变成 2Km，分子是 Km，正好得到 Vmax/2，这正是 Km 的操作定义。v 不可能超过 Vmax，所以两倍或相等的说法都违背方程的上界；四分之一对应的是 [S] = Km/3。
quiz.explain_en: Substituting [S] = Km into v = Vmax[S]/(Km + [S]) makes the denominator 2Km against a numerator of Km, giving exactly Vmax/2 — this is the operational definition of Km. The rate can never exceed Vmax, so twice Vmax or equal to Vmax both violate the equation's ceiling, and a quarter of Vmax corresponds to [S] = Km/3.

title_zh: 复习段：米氏方程三个假设的回顾与考试提醒
title_en: Review segment: recapping the three assumptions and what the exam may ask

points.zh: 这一段不是新内容，老师带着从头回顾整条推导，反复强调考的就是那三个假设。
points.en: This stretch introduces nothing new — the lecturer walks back through the whole derivation, hammering on the three assumptions as the examinable core.

points.zh: 假设一：反应刚开始的初期，product 转回过渡态那一步（k4）速率非常小，可以忽略。
points.en: First assumption: in the early phase of the reaction the step converting product back (k4) is so slow that it can be ignored.

points.zh: 假设二：反应过程中 ES 的生成速率与降解速率相等，这才叫稳态。
points.en: Second assumption: during the reaction ES is generated and degraded at equal rates — that is what steady state means.

points.zh: 假设三：底物浓度远远大于酶浓度时反应达到最高速率，且总的酶浓度与结合态酶浓度基本相等，因为所有酶都被饱和了。
points.en: Third assumption: with substrate far in excess of enzyme the reaction reaches its maximal rate, and total enzyme is taken as essentially equal to bound enzyme because every molecule is saturated.

points.zh: 老师判断这位教授"比较复古"，很可能直接问米氏方程当年是怎么被推导出来的。
points.en: The lecturer reckons the professor is old-school and may well ask outright how the Michaelis-Menten equation was originally derived.

points.zh: 米氏方程被称为生物化学里非常重要的一个方程，所以推导过程本身是可能的考点。
points.en: The Michaelis-Menten equation is described as one of the most important in biochemistry, which is why the derivation itself is a plausible exam question.

points.zh: 老师给出的通过标准：只要能把这三个假设说出来就可以，中间代数不必背。
points.en: The stated pass criterion: being able to state the three assumptions is enough; the intermediate algebra need not be memorised.

points.zh: 老师承诺后面每次课开始还会再复习一遍，通过不断强化把这三个假设记牢。
points.en: The lecturer promises to revisit this at the start of later sessions, drilling the three assumptions by repetition.

extra.zh: 忽略 k4 的严格条件是测初速度 v0，即 [P] ≈ 0，通常要求反应进行不超过底物的 5%。这也是为什么所有酶动力学数据都必须取反应进程曲线起始的直线段——一旦产物积累，逆反应和产物抑制都会让测得的速率偏低。
extra.en: Neglecting k4 is rigorous only under initial-rate conditions, [P] near zero, conventionally less than about 5% substrate turnover. That is why kinetic data must be taken from the initial linear portion of the progress curve — once product accumulates, both the reverse reaction and product inhibition drag the measured rate down.

extra.zh: 口述推导时可以用这条完整链条：v = k3[ES] → 稳态给出 k1[E][S] =（k2 + k3）[ES] → 令 Km =（k2 + k3）/ k1 → 代入守恒式 [E]总 = [E] + [ES] → 得 v = kcat[E]总[S] /（Km + [S]），其中 Vmax = kcat[E]总。五步即可完整复述，比背中间代数可靠得多。
extra.en: A clean chain to recite: v = k3[ES], then the steady state gives k1[E][S] = (k2 + k3)[ES], then define Km = (k2 + k3)/k1, then apply conservation [E]total = [E] + [ES], and finally v = kcat[E]total[S]/(Km + [S]) with Vmax = kcat[E]total. Five steps reproduce the whole derivation far more reliably than memorising the algebra.

extra.zh: 米氏方程只适用于单底物、无协同效应、初速度条件下的酶。别构酶 allosteric enzyme 的 v–[S] 曲线是 S 形 sigmoidal，需要用 Hill 方程描述，并不遵循米氏动力学；对这类酶报告 Km 是不恰当的，应报告 K0.5 与 Hill 系数。
extra.en: The Michaelis-Menten equation applies only to single-substrate, non-cooperative enzymes under initial-rate conditions. Allosteric enzymes give a sigmoidal v–[S] curve described by the Hill equation and do not obey Michaelis-Menten kinetics; quoting a Km for them is inappropriate, and K0.5 with a Hill coefficient should be reported instead.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么推导中可以忽略 product 转回 ES 的那一步（k4）？
quiz.q_en: Why can the step taking product back to ES (k4) be neglected in the derivation?

options.zh: 该步的速率常数 k4 在数值上恒为零
options.en: The rate constant k4 for that step is identically zero

options.zh: 产物一旦生成就立刻被稀释出体系
options.en: Product is diluted out of the system the moment it is formed

options.zh: 初速度条件下产物浓度接近于零
options.en: Initial-rate conditions keep product concentration near zero

options.zh: 产物与酶之间不存在任何结合能力
options.en: The product has no measurable binding capacity for the enzyme

quiz.explain_zh: k4 这一步的速率是 k4[E][P]，反应刚开始时 [P] 几乎为零，所以整项可忽略——被忽略的是浓度而不是常数本身。说 k4 恒为零把可逆反应说死了；说产物完全不结合酶与产物抑制现象矛盾；产物在密闭体系里并不会被稀释掉。
quiz.explain_en: The rate of that step is k4[E][P], and at the start [P] is essentially zero, so the whole term drops out — it is the concentration that vanishes, not the constant. Calling k4 identically zero would make the step irreversible by fiat, claiming the product cannot bind contradicts product inhibition, and nothing dilutes product out of a closed assay.

quiz.q_zh: 下面哪一条不属于米氏方程推导的三个假设？
quiz.q_en: Which statement is NOT one of the three assumptions behind the Michaelis-Menten derivation?

options.zh: 酶与底物的结合过程是完全不可逆的
options.en: Binding of enzyme to substrate is a completely irreversible event

options.zh: 产物逆转回 ES 的一步速率小到可忽略
options.en: The step running product back to ES is slow enough to neglect

options.zh: ES 的生成速率与分解速率彼此相等
options.en: The rates of ES formation and ES breakdown are equal to each other

options.zh: 底物浓度远远大于体系中酶的浓度
options.en: Substrate concentration greatly exceeds the enzyme concentration

quiz.explain_zh: 结合不可逆恰恰与推导矛盾：k2 描述的正是 ES 散回 E + S，如果结合不可逆，Km 分子上的 k2 就不存在了。忽略产物回头、ES 生成与分解相等、底物远过量，这三条正是老师反复强调的三个假设。
quiz.explain_en: Irreversible binding directly contradicts the derivation: k2 is precisely the dissociation of ES back to E + S, and without it the k2 term in the numerator of Km would not exist. Neglecting the reverse step from product, equating ES formation with breakdown, and having substrate in large excess are exactly the three assumptions the lecturer drills.

title_zh: 米氏方程推导的骨架：三个假设与反应式
title_en: Backbone of the Michaelis-Menten derivation: three assumptions and the reaction scheme

points.zh: 老师强调：考试问到推导时，能把三个假设说出来基本就够了，符号的细节可以不背。
points.en: The lecturer stresses that if the exam asks about the derivation, being able to state the three assumptions is essentially enough; the symbol manipulation need not be memorised.

points.zh: 推导的第一步是写出反应式：底物加酶 E + S 经正、逆反应生成 ES，ES 再经正、逆反应给出酶加产物 E + P。
points.en: Step one is to write the scheme: E + S goes forward and back to ES, and ES goes forward and back to enzyme plus product, E + P.

points.zh: 假设一：在反应刚开始的初期，product 转回 ES 这一步的速率非常小，可以忽略 —— 也就是只测 initial velocity。
points.en: Assumption one: early in the reaction the step converting product back to ES is so slow it can be ignored — that is, only the initial velocity is measured.

points.zh: 假设二：反应过程中 ES 的生成速率和降解速率相等，这就是 steady state 稳态假设。
points.en: Assumption two: during the reaction ES is formed and broken down at equal rates — the steady-state assumption.

points.zh: 假设三（课上的说法）：当底物浓度远远大于酶时，总的酶浓度和 ES 的浓度基本相等，因为酶都被饱和了。
points.en: Assumption three as stated in class: when substrate concentration far exceeds enzyme, total enzyme concentration is essentially equal to [ES], because the enzyme is all saturated.

points.zh: 之所以必须先把 ES 表示出来，是因为要靠 ES 才能把 substrate 和 product 连接起来。
points.en: ES has to be expressed first because ES is what links substrate to product.

points.zh: “表示出 ES”具体就是分别写出它正向的生成速率和逆向被消灭掉的速率这两个式子。
points.en: "Expressing ES" means writing out two rate expressions: the rate at which it is formed and the rate at which it is consumed.

extra.zh: 课上多次把 ES 叫作“过渡态”。ES 是 Michaelis complex，是基态 (ground state) 的中间物，可以用动力学方法测量、有确定的浓度；transition state 是能垒顶端的构型，寿命约为一次键振动 (10⁻¹³ s)，无法分离也无法测浓度。酶的催化本质是稳定 transition state，不是稳定 ES。
extra.en: The lecture repeatedly calls ES the "transition state". ES is the Michaelis complex — a ground-state intermediate with a real, measurable concentration. The transition state sits at the top of the energy barrier, lasts about one bond vibration (10⁻¹³ s), and cannot be isolated or measured. Catalysis works by stabilising the transition state, not by stabilising ES.

extra.zh: 假设三的标准形式是酶的质量守恒 [E]t = [E]free + [ES]，在任何底物浓度下都成立，推导里用的正是它。[S] >> [E] 的真正作用是让游离底物浓度约等于加进去的总底物浓度。而 [ES] ≈ [E]t 只有在 [S] >> Km（饱和）时才成立，不是推导的前提。
extra.en: The standard form of assumption three is enzyme mass conservation, [E]total = [E]free + [ES], which holds at any substrate concentration and is what the derivation actually uses. What [S] >> [E] really buys you is that free substrate ≈ the total substrate you added. [ES] ≈ [E]total holds only at saturation ([S] >> Km) and is not a premise of the derivation.

extra.zh: 原始的 Michaelis-Menten (1913) 推导用的是 rapid equilibrium 假设（k3 << k2，E+S 与 ES 处于快速平衡）；Briggs 和 Haldane (1925) 把它换成 steady state 假设，才得到 Km = (k2+k3)/k1。今天教科书和课上讲的都是 Briggs-Haldane 版本。
extra.en: The original Michaelis-Menten (1913) derivation used a rapid-equilibrium assumption (k3 << k2, so E+S and ES stay in fast equilibrium). Briggs and Haldane (1925) replaced it with the steady-state assumption, which is what yields Km = (k2+k3)/k1. Today's textbooks — and this lecture — use the Briggs-Haldane version.

quiz.q_zh: 米氏方程推导中“稳态假设”的确切含义是什么？
quiz.q_en: What exactly does the steady-state assumption in the Michaelis-Menten derivation state?

options.zh: 底物浓度在反应过程中保持恒定
options.en: Substrate concentration stays constant through the run

options.zh: ES 的生成速率等于其分解速率
options.en: ES is formed and broken down at equal rates

options.zh: 酶与底物之间达到热力学平衡
options.en: Enzyme and substrate reach thermodynamic equilibrium

options.zh: 产物生成速率等于底物消耗速率
options.en: Product appears as fast as substrate disappears

quiz.explain_zh: 稳态假设针对的是中间物 ES：它的浓度在初速率阶段基本不变，因为生成与分解速率相等，由此得到 k1[E][S] = (k2+k3)[ES]。“酶与底物达到热力学平衡”是另一套前提（rapid equilibrium，原始 M-M 推导），不是稳态；底物浓度恒定和产物、底物速率相等都不是这一假设的内容。
quiz.explain_en: The steady state refers to the intermediate ES: its concentration is essentially unchanging during the initial-velocity phase because formation and breakdown rates are equal, giving k1[E][S] = (k2+k3)[ES]. Enzyme and substrate reaching thermodynamic equilibrium is a different premise (rapid equilibrium, the original M-M derivation), not the steady state; constant substrate and equal substrate/product rates are not what this assumption says.

quiz.q_zh: 推导中为什么必须先把 ES 的生成与消耗速率写出来？
quiz.q_en: Why must the formation and consumption rates of ES be written out first in the derivation?

options.zh: ES 的生成是整个反应的 rate-limiting step
options.en: ES formation is the rate-limiting step

options.zh: ES 是能量最高的 transition state
options.en: ES is the highest-energy transition state

options.zh: ES 的浓度可用 spectrophotometry 测出
options.en: ES concentration is directly measurable

options.zh: ES 把 substrate 与 product 连接起来
options.en: ES is what links substrate to product

quiz.explain_zh: 反应速率写成 v = k3[ES]，唯一含中间物的量就是 [ES]，而 [ES] 实验上测不到，所以必须先把它表示出来、再用可测的 [E]t 和 [S] 换掉，这正是整个推导的目的。能量最高的是 transition state 而不是 ES；ES 的浓度通常无法直接测；多数酶的限速步是催化步 k3 而不是结合步。
quiz.explain_en: The rate is v = k3[ES], so [ES] is the only intermediate term — and it cannot be measured experimentally. It must therefore be expressed and then eliminated in favour of the measurable [E]total and [S], which is the whole point of the derivation. The highest-energy species is the transition state, not ES; [ES] is generally not directly measurable; and for most enzymes the rate-limiting step is the catalytic step k3, not binding.

title_zh: 引入 Km 与 k3：推导的实际顺序
title_en: Bringing in Km and k3: the actual order of the derivation

points.zh: 老师当场纠正了自己的顺序：不是先引入 Km，而是先用假设二（稳态），让 ES 的生成速率与消除速率相等。
points.en: The lecturer corrects the order on the spot: assumption two (steady state) comes first — ES formation rate is set equal to its removal rate — and only then does Km appear.

points.zh: 引入 Km 的动机很直白：把一堆速率常数 k 用一个统一的符号打包表示出来，让式子好看。
points.en: The motive for introducing Km is plainly stated: pack the several rate constants k into one unified symbol so the expression becomes tidy.

points.zh: 稳态式整理后得到 k1[E][S] = (k2+k3)[ES]，于是定义 Km = (k2+k3)/k1，单位是浓度。
points.en: Rearranging the steady-state equality gives k1[E][S] = (k2+k3)[ES], so Km is defined as (k2+k3)/k1, with units of concentration.

points.zh: 引入 Km 之后老师说式子“还是不是很简洁”，于是接着引入“我们真实测定的 k3”，也就是催化步骤的速率常数。
points.en: After Km the lecturer says the expression is still not neat enough, so k3 — "the one we actually measure" — is brought in: the rate constant of the catalytic step.

points.zh: 速率方程 v = k3[ES]，其中 k3 就是 kcat，即每个酶分子每秒的 turnover number。
points.en: The rate equation is v = k3[ES], where k3 is kcat, the turnover number — molecules converted per enzyme molecule per second.

points.zh: 最后一步才用假设三，把总酶浓度代进去，消掉方程里测不到的游离酶浓度。
points.en: Only at the last step is assumption three used, substituting total enzyme concentration and eliminating the unmeasurable free-enzyme term.

points.zh: 老师的总结口诀：三步假设、两步引入（Km 与 k3），最后就得到了米氏方程。
points.en: The lecturer's summary: three assumptions, two substitutions (Km and k3), and out comes the Michaelis-Menten equation.

extra.zh: Km = (k2+k3)/k1，量纲是 mol/L。只有当 k3 << k2（催化远慢于解离）时 Km ≈ k2/k1 = Ks = Kd，才近似等于解离常数。一般情况下 Km 只是 apparent affinity 的指标：Km 越小，达到半数最大速率所需的底物越少，表观亲和力越高 —— 两者成反比。
extra.en: Km = (k2+k3)/k1, with units of mol/L. Only when k3 << k2 (catalysis much slower than dissociation) does Km ≈ k2/k1 = Ks = Kd, i.e. approximate the dissociation constant. In general Km is only an index of apparent affinity: a smaller Km means less substrate is needed to reach half-maximal velocity, so apparent affinity is higher — the two are inversely related.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 课上把 k3 说成“我们真实测定的”。实验上直接得到的是 Vmax（而且是外推值），k3 = kcat = Vmax/[E]t，必须另外知道酶的摩尔浓度才能算出来。反过来说，如果只有粗酶提取物、不知道酶的摩尔量，就只能报 Vmax 或比活力，报不了 kcat。
extra.en: The lecture calls k3 "the one we actually measure". What the experiment gives directly is Vmax (and even that is extrapolated); k3 = kcat = Vmax/[E]total, which requires separately knowing the molar concentration of enzyme. With a crude extract of unknown molarity you can report Vmax or specific activity, but not kcat.

extra.zh: kcat/Km 是 specificity constant，描述低底物浓度下酶对某个底物的催化效率，也是比较同一个酶对不同底物偏好的正确参数。它的上限受底物扩散速率限制，约 10⁸–10⁹ M⁻¹s⁻¹；达到这个上限的酶称为 catalytically perfect，如 carbonic anhydrase、triosephosphate isomerase、acetylcholinesterase。
extra.en: kcat/Km is the specificity constant: it describes catalytic efficiency at low substrate concentration and is the correct parameter for comparing one enzyme's preference among different substrates. Its ceiling is set by the diffusion rate of substrate, around 10⁸–10⁹ M⁻¹s⁻¹; enzymes at that ceiling are called catalytically perfect — carbonic anhydrase, triosephosphate isomerase, acetylcholinesterase.

quiz.q_zh: 由稳态假设整理得到的 Km，其定义式是？
quiz.q_en: Rearranging the steady-state assumption, how is Km defined?
quiz.explain_zh: 稳态给出 k1[E][S] = (k2+k3)[ES]，移项即 [E][S]/[ES] = (k2+k3)/k1 = Km。分子是 ES 消失的两条途径（解离 k2 与催化 k3），分母是生成途径 k1。把它上下颠倒写得到的是结合常数，量纲变成 1/浓度，直接就对不上 Km 是浓度的事实。
quiz.explain_en: The steady state gives k1[E][S] = (k2+k3)[ES], so [E][S]/[ES] = (k2+k3)/k1 = Km. The numerator collects the two routes by which ES disappears (dissociation k2 and catalysis k3), the denominator the route by which it forms (k1). Inverting the ratio gives an association constant with units of 1/concentration, which contradicts the fact that Km is a concentration.

quiz.q_zh: Km 与酶对底物的亲和力之间是什么关系？
quiz.q_en: How does Km relate to an enzyme's affinity for its substrate?

options.zh: Km 越小，表观亲和力越高
options.en: A smaller Km means higher apparent affinity

options.zh: Km 越大，表观亲和力越高
options.en: A larger Km means higher apparent affinity

options.zh: Km 与亲和力无关，只反映 Vmax
options.en: Km says nothing of affinity, only of Vmax

options.zh: Km 越小，酶的催化速率越快
options.en: A smaller Km means a faster catalytic rate

quiz.explain_zh: Km 是达到 1/2 Vmax 所需的底物浓度，需要的底物越少说明结合越有效，所以 Km 与表观亲和力成反比。催化的快慢由 kcat 决定，Km 与 kcat 是两个互相独立的参数，一个小 Km 的酶完全可以催化得很慢；Km 与 Vmax 也不是同一件事。
quiz.explain_en: Km is the substrate concentration needed to reach half of Vmax; needing less substrate means binding is more effective, so Km is inversely related to apparent affinity. How fast catalysis runs is set by kcat, an independent parameter — an enzyme with a small Km can still turn over slowly — and Km is not a restatement of Vmax.

title_zh: 米氏方程的写法：v = Vmax[S] / (Km + [S])
title_en: Writing the Michaelis-Menten equation: v = Vmax[S] / (Km + [S])

points.zh: 老师提出明确的底线要求：推导不会无所谓，但方程怎么写“一定一定要知道”。
points.en: The lecturer sets an explicit floor: not knowing the derivation is survivable, but you absolutely must know how the equation is written.

points.zh: 分子是 Vmax 乘以底物浓度 [S]；分母是 Km 加上底物浓度 [S]，即 v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S])。
points.en: The numerator is Vmax times substrate concentration [S]; the denominator is Km plus [S], i.e. v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S]).

points.zh: v 是在某一个底物浓度下、这一时刻酶促反应的反应速率，它随 [S] 不同而不同。
points.en: v is the rate of the enzyme reaction at that moment for a given substrate concentration; it differs with [S].

points.zh: Vmax 是这个酶在固定条件下的最大酶活，是一个定值。
points.en: Vmax is that enzyme's maximal activity under a fixed set of conditions — a constant value.

points.zh: Km 同样是一个固定的数值，不随实验中加多少底物而改变。
points.en: Km is likewise a fixed number and does not change with how much substrate is put into the experiment.

points.zh: 整个反应式里出现的量就只有 v、Vmax、Km、[S] 这几个，其中只有 [S] 在变。
points.en: The whole expression contains only v, Vmax, Km and [S], and of these only [S] varies.

points.zh: 老师承诺下节课开始前会再花时间强调一遍米氏方程的来历。
points.en: The lecturer promises to spend time at the start of the next session re-emphasising where the equation comes from.

extra.zh: 把 [S] = Km 代入方程：v = Vmax·Km/(Km+Km) = Vmax/2。所以 Km 的操作定义就是达到半数最大速率所需的底物浓度 —— 这是最常考的一句话，也是从图上读 Km 的方法。
extra.en: Substituting [S] = Km gives v = Vmax·Km/(Km+Km) = Vmax/2. Hence the operational definition: Km is the substrate concentration giving half-maximal velocity — the single most examinable sentence about it, and the way Km is read off a plot.

extra.zh: 反应级数直接由方程读出：[S] << Km 时分母 ≈ Km，v ≈ (Vmax/Km)[S]，对底物是一级反应；[S] >> Km 时分母 ≈ [S]，v ≈ Vmax，对底物是零级反应。分界线是 [S] 相对于 Km，与酶浓度无关 —— “底物分子数多于酶分子数”在几乎所有实验里都成立，却完全不等于饱和。
extra.en: Reaction order falls straight out of the equation: when [S] << Km the denominator ≈ Km and v ≈ (Vmax/Km)[S], first order in substrate; when [S] >> Km the denominator ≈ [S] and v ≈ Vmax, zero order. The boundary is [S] relative to Km, not to enzyme — substrate molecules outnumbering enzyme molecules is true in nearly every experiment yet says nothing about saturation.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 课上说 Vmax 是“真正做实验的时候测定的数值”。严格讲 Vmax 只有在 [S] → ∞ 时才达到，实验上永远只能逼近，实际是用非线性拟合或双倒数作图外推得到的。考试中若问“Vmax 能否直接测得”，答案是不能，只能外推。
extra.en: The lecture calls Vmax "the number you actually measure in the experiment". Strictly, Vmax is reached only as [S] → ∞; experimentally you can only approach it, and the value is obtained by non-linear fitting or by extrapolation from a double-reciprocal plot. If asked whether Vmax can be measured directly, the answer is no — only extrapolated.

extra.zh: Vmax 不是酶的内在常数：Vmax = kcat·[E]t，与加入的总酶浓度成正比。同一个酶多加一倍，Vmax 翻倍而 Km 完全不变。真正只属于酶本身、与用量无关的常数是 kcat 和 kcat/Km。
extra.en: Vmax is not an intrinsic property of the enzyme: Vmax = kcat·[E]total, proportional to how much enzyme you added. Double the enzyme and Vmax doubles while Km is untouched. The constants that belong to the enzyme itself, independent of amount used, are kcat and kcat/Km.

quiz.q_zh: 当底物浓度恰好等于 Km 时，反应速率 v 等于多少？
quiz.q_en: When substrate concentration is exactly equal to Km, what is the velocity v?

options.zh: Vmax 的两倍
options.en: Twice Vmax

options.zh: Vmax 本身
options.en: Vmax itself

options.zh: Vmax 的一半
options.en: Half of Vmax

options.zh: Vmax 的三分之一
options.en: A third of Vmax

quiz.explain_zh: 把 [S] = Km 代入 v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S])，分母变成 2Km，约分后 v = Vmax/2。这正是 Km 的操作定义：半数最大速率对应的底物浓度。v 永远不可能超过 Vmax，所以“两倍”在数学上就不成立；等于 Vmax 只在 [S] 趋于无穷时才逼近。
quiz.explain_en: Substituting [S] = Km into v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S]) makes the denominator 2Km, and cancelling gives v = Vmax/2. This is exactly the operational definition of Km: the substrate concentration at half-maximal velocity. v can never exceed Vmax, so twice Vmax is mathematically impossible, and v equals Vmax only as [S] approaches infinity.

quiz.q_zh: 把加入的酶量加倍、其他条件不变，米氏方程的参数会怎样变化？
quiz.q_en: If the amount of enzyme is doubled and nothing else changes, how do the Michaelis-Menten parameters respond?

options.zh: Vmax 与 Km 都不变
options.en: Neither Vmax nor Km changes

options.zh: Km 加倍，Vmax 不变
options.en: Km doubles, Vmax is unchanged

options.zh: Vmax 加倍，Km 不变
options.en: Vmax doubles, Km is unchanged

options.zh: Vmax 与 Km 都加倍
options.en: Both Vmax and Km double

quiz.explain_zh: Vmax = kcat[E]t，与酶的总浓度成正比，所以酶加倍则 Vmax 加倍。Km = (k2+k3)/k1 只由速率常数决定，是酶与底物这一对搭配的性质，与加了多少酶无关。正因如此，跨实验室比较酶的性能要用 kcat 和 kcat/Km，而不是 Vmax。
quiz.explain_en: Vmax = kcat[E]total, proportional to total enzyme, so doubling the enzyme doubles Vmax. Km = (k2+k3)/k1 depends only on rate constants — a property of that enzyme-substrate pairing — and is indifferent to how much enzyme was added. This is precisely why enzymes are compared across labs by kcat and kcat/Km rather than by Vmax.

title_zh: Vmax、Km 是定值，[S] 是唯一变量；下节课预告
title_en: Vmax and Km are constants, [S] the only variable; preview of the next session

points.zh: Vmax 在某一固定条件下就是一个固定数值，因为某种酶的最大酶活在给定条件下是确定的。
points.en: Vmax is a fixed number under a given set of conditions, because a particular enzyme's maximal activity is determined once conditions are fixed.

points.zh: Km 同样是固定数值；老师给出的理由是 ES 已经处在生成与消除相等的稳态里。
points.en: Km is likewise fixed; the reason offered in class is that ES is already in the steady state where formation and removal are equal.

points.zh: 方程里唯一的变量是底物浓度 [S]，因为实验中 [S] 是随时在变的那一个量。
points.en: The only variable in the equation is [S], because substrate concentration is the quantity that changes throughout the experiment.

points.zh: 老师因此把米氏方程类比成“y = kx 那样的一个方程，只不过长成这个样子”。
points.en: On that basis the lecturer likens the equation to "a y = kx sort of equation, just written in this shape".

points.zh: 下节课的第一个内容：米氏方程的作图是怎么做的。
points.en: First item next session: how the Michaelis-Menten equation is plotted.

points.zh: 下节课的第二个内容：抑制剂 inhibitor 是怎么改变这条曲线的。
points.en: Second item next session: how inhibitors change the shape of that curve.

points.zh: 再往后会讲具体案例，例如糖苷酶 glycosidase 是怎么催化的。
points.en: Later still come worked cases, for example how glycosidases carry out catalysis.

points.zh: 老师点明整套推导之所以看着复杂，目的恰恰是把这个关系写成最简单的形式。
points.en: The lecturer points out that the derivation looks elaborate precisely because its goal is to render the relationship in its simplest possible form.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 米氏方程不是 y = kx 那样的直线，而是 rectangular hyperbola（直角双曲线），以 Vmax 为水平渐近线。只有在 [S] << Km 的低浓度段它才近似为过原点、斜率 Vmax/Km 的直线。要得到真正的直线需作 Lineweaver-Burk 双倒数图：1/v = (Km/Vmax)(1/[S]) + 1/Vmax。
extra.en: The Michaelis-Menten equation is not a straight line like y = kx but a rectangular hyperbola with Vmax as its horizontal asymptote. Only in the low range where [S] << Km does it approximate a straight line through the origin with slope Vmax/Km. A genuinely straight line requires the Lineweaver-Burk double-reciprocal plot: 1/v = (Km/Vmax)(1/[S]) + 1/Vmax.

extra.zh: 课上说“Km 代表的含义是 ES 这个东西的反应速率”。Km 的量纲是浓度不是速率，它等于 (k2+k3)/k1，也等于半数最大速率时的底物浓度。Km 之所以是常数，是因为它由几个速率常数组成，与 ES 是否处于稳态无关。
extra.en: The lecture says "what Km means is the reaction rate of the ES thing". Km has units of concentration, not rate; it equals (k2+k3)/k1 and equals the substrate concentration at half-maximal velocity. Km is constant because it is built from rate constants, not because ES happens to be in a steady state.

extra.zh: 下节课的抑制剂内容有固定的考点表：competitive inhibitor 升高表观 Km、Vmax 不变；uncompetitive inhibitor 把表观 Km 与 Vmax 同比例降低；noncompetitive（纯粹型）降低 Vmax、Km 不变。三者在双倒数图上的交点位置各不相同，是最常见的读图题。
extra.en: The inhibitor material coming next session has a fixed examinable table: a competitive inhibitor raises apparent Km with Vmax unchanged; an uncompetitive inhibitor lowers apparent Km and Vmax by the same factor; a pure noncompetitive inhibitor lowers Vmax with Km unchanged. Each gives a different intersection point on the double-reciprocal plot, the classic plot-reading question.

extra.zh: 糖苷酶（如 lysozyme、β-galactosidase）的机制值得先记住轮廓：都用一对羧酸残基做 general acid/base 催化。retaining 型经两次亲核取代、走共价糖基-酶中间物，端基构型保留；inverting 型一步水解、构型翻转。这正是“ES 之后还有共价中间物”的典型例子。
extra.en: It is worth pre-loading the outline of the glycosidase mechanism (lysozyme, β-galactosidase): both use a pair of carboxylate residues for general acid/base catalysis. Retaining enzymes go through two successive nucleophilic substitutions via a covalent glycosyl-enzyme intermediate, preserving anomeric configuration; inverting enzymes hydrolyse in a single step and invert it. This is the textbook case of a covalent intermediate lying beyond ES.

quiz.q_zh: 直接以 v 对 [S] 作图，米氏方程给出的曲线是什么形状？
quiz.q_en: Plotting v directly against [S], what shape does the Michaelis-Menten equation give?

options.zh: 趋于 Vmax 的双曲线
options.en: A hyperbola levelling off at Vmax

options.zh: 过原点的一条直线
options.en: A straight line through the origin

options.zh: 对称的钟形曲线
options.en: A symmetric bell-shaped curve

options.zh: 陡然上升的 S 形曲线
options.en: A steeply rising sigmoid curve

quiz.explain_zh: v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S]) 是 rectangular hyperbola，随 [S] 升高以 Vmax 为渐近线逐渐变平。直线只在 [S] << Km 的低端近似成立，不是整条曲线的形状；S 形曲线出现在有协同性的别构酶上，它们不服从米氏动力学；钟形曲线是酶活对 pH 或温度作图才有的形状。
quiz.explain_en: v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S]) is a rectangular hyperbola that flattens towards Vmax as [S] rises. A straight line is only the low-[S] approximation, not the shape of the whole curve; sigmoid curves belong to cooperative allosteric enzymes, which do not obey Michaelis-Menten kinetics; and a bell shape is what you get plotting activity against pH or temperature.

quiz.q_zh: 在什么条件下酶促反应对底物近似为零级反应？
quiz.q_en: Under what condition is an enzyme reaction approximately zero order in substrate?

options.zh: [S] 远小于 Km
options.en: [S] far below Km

options.zh: [S] 远大于 [E]
options.en: [S] far above [E]

options.zh: [S] 恰好等于 Km
options.en: [S] exactly equal to Km

options.zh: [S] 远大于 Km
options.en: [S] far above Km

quiz.explain_zh: 零级意味着速率不再随底物浓度变化，只有酶被底物饱和时才出现，而饱和的判据是 [S] >> Km，此时分母 ≈ [S]，v ≈ Vmax。[S] 远小于 Km 给的是一级反应；[S] 远大于 [E] 在几乎所有酶学实验里都成立，却完全不保证饱和；[S] = Km 时速率恰在 Vmax 的一半，正处在曲线弯曲最明显的地方。
quiz.explain_en: Zero order means the rate no longer depends on substrate concentration, which happens only when the enzyme is saturated — and the criterion for saturation is [S] >> Km, where the denominator ≈ [S] and v ≈ Vmax. [S] far below Km gives first-order behaviour; [S] far above [E] holds in almost every enzyme experiment yet guarantees nothing about saturation; and at [S] = Km the rate is half-maximal, right where the curve bends most.

title_zh: 课堂收尾与复习安排（非讲授内容）
title_en: Wrap-up and revision plan (not lecture content proper)

points.zh: 这一段是课堂收尾的对话，不再有新的知识点：学生说“我有一点点轮廓了”，老师说自己当年学得很透彻所以能讲清楚。
points.en: This stretch is closing chat rather than teaching: the student says the outline is starting to form, and the lecturer credits having learned it thoroughly himself for being able to explain it.

points.zh: 今天讲到米氏方程为止；老师判断再讲下去效率会很低，所以到此结束。
points.en: Today's session ends at the Michaelis-Menten equation; the lecturer judges that carrying on would be inefficient and stops there.

points.zh: 下节课开头会详细回顾米氏方程到底是怎么来的：几个假设、几次代入，按顺序再走一遍。
points.en: The next session will open with a detailed recap of where the equation comes from — the assumptions and the substitutions, walked through in order.

points.zh: 老师给出的学习地形图：米氏方程之前的内容都还好，从米氏方程开始就是大量的数学推导。
points.en: The lecturer's map of the terrain: everything before the Michaelis-Menten equation is manageable, and heavy mathematical derivation starts here.

points.zh: 学生的自我评估只是“有轮廓”，说明推导需要自己动手复算一遍才能固定下来。
points.en: The student's own assessment is only "an outline", which means the derivation needs to be re-worked by hand before it will stick.

extra.zh: 自己复算的最短路径共六行：① E+S ⇌(k1,k2) ES →(k3) E+P；② v = k3[ES]；③ 稳态 k1[E][S] = (k2+k3)[ES]；④ 代入 [E] = [E]t − [ES]；⑤ 定义 Km = (k2+k3)/k1，解出 [ES] = [E]t[S]/(Km+[S])；⑥ 代回得 v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S])，其中 Vmax = k3[E]t。能默写这六行，任何形式的推导题都能应付。
extra.en: The shortest route to re-deriving it yourself is six lines: (1) E+S ⇌(k1,k2) ES →(k3) E+P; (2) v = k3[ES]; (3) steady state, k1[E][S] = (k2+k3)[ES]; (4) substitute [E] = [E]total − [ES]; (5) define Km = (k2+k3)/k1 and solve for [ES] = [E]total[S]/(Km+[S]); (6) substitute back to get v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S]) with Vmax = k3[E]total. Being able to write those six lines from memory covers any version of the derivation question.

extra.zh: 下节课的作图法要点可以先记：Lineweaver-Burk 双倒数图横截距为 −1/Km、纵截距为 1/Vmax、斜率为 Km/Vmax。但它把低 [S] 处本就最大的实验误差进一步放大，所以现代实际做法是对双曲线直接做非线性拟合，双倒数图主要用于教学和判读抑制类型。
extra.en: Worth pre-loading for the plotting session: on a Lineweaver-Burk double-reciprocal plot the x-intercept is −1/Km, the y-intercept 1/Vmax and the slope Km/Vmax. Because it amplifies the already-largest errors at low [S], modern practice fits the hyperbola non-linearly, and the double-reciprocal plot survives mainly for teaching and for diagnosing inhibition type.

extra.zh: 米氏动力学的适用范围有限：单底物（或其他底物过量而近似单底物）、无协同性的酶。别构酶 allosteric enzyme 给出 S 形曲线，用 Hill 方程和 K0.5 描述，不能套 Km；多底物酶还要区分 sequential 与 ping-pong 机制。考试中把 Km 用在别构酶上是常见的失分点。
extra.en: Michaelis-Menten kinetics has a limited domain: single-substrate enzymes (or ones made pseudo-single-substrate by saturating the others) without cooperativity. Allosteric enzymes give sigmoid curves described by the Hill equation and K0.5, not Km; multi-substrate enzymes further split into sequential and ping-pong mechanisms. Applying Km to an allosteric enzyme is a routine way to lose marks.

quiz.q_zh: 米氏方程中 Vmax 与 kcat 的关系是？
quiz.q_en: How are Vmax and kcat related in the Michaelis-Menten framework?

options.zh: kcat = Vmax × Km
options.en: kcat = Vmax × Km

options.zh: kcat = Vmax × [E]t
options.en: kcat = Vmax × [E]total

options.zh: kcat = Vmax / [E]t
options.en: kcat = Vmax / [E]total

options.zh: kcat = Vmax / Km
options.en: kcat = Vmax / Km

quiz.explain_zh: 最大速率出现在全部酶都以 ES 形式存在时，此时 v = k3[E]t，所以 Vmax = kcat[E]t，反解得 kcat = Vmax/[E]t，单位是 s⁻¹，即 turnover number。含 Km 的组合另有含义：kcat/Km 才是 specificity constant，而 Vmax/Km 不是一个标准参数。
quiz.explain_en: Maximal velocity occurs when all enzyme is present as ES, where v = k3[E]total, so Vmax = kcat[E]total and hence kcat = Vmax/[E]total, in units of s⁻¹ — the turnover number. Combinations involving Km mean something else: kcat/Km is the specificity constant, while Vmax/Km is not a standard parameter.

quiz.q_zh: 推导米氏方程时坚持“只测初速率”，主要是为了什么？
quiz.q_en: In deriving the equation, what is the main purpose of insisting on initial velocities only?

options.zh: 使酶的构象在反应中固定不变
options.en: So the enzyme's conformation stays fixed throughout

options.zh: 使底物浓度远远高于酶浓度
options.en: So substrate concentration far exceeds enzyme

options.zh: 使产物逆向生成 ES 可以忽略
options.en: So the back reaction from product to ES is negligible

options.zh: 使酶浓度在反应中保持恒定
options.en: So the enzyme concentration stays constant

quiz.explain_zh: 初速率阶段产物几乎还没有积累，逆向的 E + P → ES 一项可以直接丢掉，方程才能写成不含 [P] 的简单形式；同时底物只消耗了百分之几，[S] 可以当作加入时的浓度。酶浓度守恒来自质量守恒，与是否测初速率无关；[S] >> [E] 是配液时决定的；诱导契合本来就意味着酶的构象会改变。
quiz.explain_en: In the initial-velocity phase almost no product has accumulated, so the reverse term E + P → ES can simply be dropped, letting the equation be written without [P]; at the same time only a few percent of substrate is consumed, so [S] can be taken as the concentration added. Enzyme conservation follows from mass balance regardless of when you measure; [S] >> [E] is decided when the assay is set up; and induced fit means the enzyme's conformation does change.
